Meanwhile, disastrous fires forced further evacuations in France and Spain, and Russia launched a night-time missile attack on Kiev. In Brazil, the son of former president Jair Bolsonaro officially announced his run for president.

data.title: Rowerem przez pływający most środkiem jeziora. Atrakcja zachwyca turystów
data.description: Belgijska Limburgia oferuje niezwykłą atrakcję dla miłośników dwóch kółek. Trasa prowadzi przez pływający most pośrodku jeziora Terhills, dzięki czemu rowerzyści mogą odnieść wrażenie, że jadą bezpośrednio po tafli wody.
data.translatedTitle: Cycling across the floating bridge in the middle of the lake. The attraction delights tourists
data.translatedDescription: Belgian Limburg offers an extraordinary attraction for lovers of two wheels. The route leads over a floating bridge in the middle of Lake Terhills, which gives cyclists the impression that they are riding directly on the surface of the water.

data.title: Od 1 września nowe zasady oceniania uczniów. MEN szykuje projekt
data.description: Ministerstwo Edukacji Narodowej przygotowało projekt zmian dotyczących egzaminów klasyfikacyjnych i poprawkowych, oceny zachowania oraz prac domowych. Nowe regulacje mają wejść w życie 1 września. Po konsultacjach resort złagodził część propozycji, ale utrzymał najważniejsze założenia projektu – informuje Portal Samorządowy.
data.translatedTitle: From September 1, new rules for assessing students. The Ministry of National Education is preparing a project
data.translatedDescription: The Ministry of National Education has prepared a draft of changes regarding classification and resit exams, behavior assessment and homework. The new regulations are to enter into force on September 1. After consultations, the ministry relaxed some of the proposals, but maintained the most important assumptions of the project - informs the Local Government Portal.

data.title: Sondaż: Radosław Sikorski wygrywa z Donaldem Tuskiem jako kandydat na przyszłego premiera
data.description: Gdyby Koalicja Obywatelska miała tworzyć rząd po wyborach parlamentarnych w 2027 roku wówczas na jego czele powinien stanąć raczej Radosław Sikorski, niż Donald Tusk - wynika z sondażu SW Research dla rp.pl.
data.translatedTitle: Poll: Radosław Sikorski beats Donald Tusk as a candidate for future prime minister
data.translatedDescription: If the Civic Coalition were to form a government after the parliamentary elections in 2027, it should be led by Radosław Sikorski rather than Donald Tusk - according to a SW Research survey for rp.pl.

data.title: Jan Maciejewski: Ośrodek Wypoczynkowy „Nieśmiertelność”
data.description: Odyseusz znalazł się w raju, o jakim nie śmie nawet marzyć każdy pogrążający się w kryzysie wieku średniego mężczyzna. I już po chwili zorientował się, że trafił do piekła.
data.translatedTitle: Jan Maciejewski: Recreation Center "Immortality"
data.translatedDescription: Odysseus found himself in a paradise that every man in midlife crisis cannot even dream of. And after a while he realized that he had gone to hell.

data.title: Drugi występ, druga porażka Chicago Fire. Robert Lewandowski nie ugasił pożaru
data.description: Robert Lewandowski wyjazdowy mecz z New York City zaczął na ławce rezerwowych. Miał ratować drużynę w drugiej połowie, ale mimo wysiłków niczego już nie zmienił. Chicago Fire przegrali 1:3.
data.translatedTitle: Second performance, second defeat for Chicago Fire. Robert Lewandowski did not put out the fire
data.translatedDescription: Robert Lewandowski started the away match against New York City on the bench. He was supposed to save the team in the second half, but despite his efforts, he didn't change anything. Chicago Fire lost 1:3.

data.title: Ważna zmiana. Karty parkingowe z orzeczeniem do wymiany w związku z unijną dyrektywą
data.description: Unijna dyrektywa do 2028 roku wprowadzi nową, jednolitą europejską kartę parkingową. To będzie oznaczać obowiązek ich wymiany za dwa lata. Tymczasem rząd chce uniknąć sytuacji, w której dokument trzeba by wymienić jeszcze raz, tyle że wcześniej. To dlatego karty parkingowe dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami mają zostać wykreślone z katalogu dokumentów publicznych trzeciej kategorii.
data.translatedTitle: Important change. Parking cards with a certificate for exchange in connection with the EU directive
data.translatedDescription: The EU directive will introduce a new, uniform European parking card by 2028. This will mean the obligation to replace them in two years. Meanwhile, the government wants to avoid a situation in which the document would have to be replaced again, but earlier. This is why parking cards for people with disabilities are to be removed from the third category public documents.

data.title: Słyszenie kolorów, smakowanie liter. 4 proc. ludzi tego doświadcza
data.description: Niektóre osoby słysząc muzykę, widzą kolory i kształty, a poszczególnym literom, liczbom lub słowom przypisują konkretne barwy albo smaki. Takie doświadczenia nazywane są synestezją. O „widzeniu” muzyki opowiadały między innymi Billie Eilish i Lady Gaga.
data.translatedTitle: Hearing colors, tasting letters. 4 percent people experience this
data.translatedDescription: Some people hear colors and shapes when they hear music, and assign specific colors or flavors to individual letters, numbers or words. Such experiences are called synesthesia. Billie Eilish and Lady Gaga, among others, talked about "seeing" music.

data.title: Ile filiżanek kawy dziennie można bezpiecznie wypić? Eksperci podali liczbę
data.description: Większość osób nie wyobraża sobie poranka bez kawy. Wątpliwości wciąż budzi jednak liczba filiżanek, która jest bezpieczna dla serca. Najnowsze stanowisko Amerykańskiego Towarzystwa Kardiologicznego przynosi odpowiedź. Naukowcy podkreślają jednocześnie, że norma ta dotyczy zdrowych osób.
data.translatedTitle: How many cups of coffee a day can you safely drink? Experts have given a number
data.translatedDescription: Most people cannot imagine a morning without coffee. However, the number of cups that is safe for the heart is still questionable. The latest position statement from the American Heart Association provides the answer. Scientists also emphasize that this standard applies to healthy people.

data.title: Sony rezygnuje z płyt. Czy to początek końca sklepów z grami?
data.description: Nie ma odwrotu od cyfrowej dystrybucji gier, bo korporacje doskonale wiedzą, że gracze tak czy siak wszystko łykną. Niezależnie od tego, czy będą musieli wykupywać regularnie abonamenty, aby grać w swoje gry, lub pogodzić się z ryzykiem, że za jakiś czas znikną one z serwera.
data.translatedTitle: Sony gives up on discs. Is this the beginning of the end for game stores?
data.translatedDescription: There is no turning back from digital game distribution, because corporations know perfectly well that players will swallow everything anyway. Regardless of whether they will have to buy regular subscriptions to play their games or accept the risk that they will disappear from the server after some time.

data.title: Koniec czatowania z botem. Uznany naukowiec zmienia sposób interakcji z AI
data.description: Prof. Andrew Ng zaprezentował OpenWorker, narzędzie które zrywa z dotychczasowym schematem chatbotów. Zamiast prowadzić konwersacje i podsuwać tekstowe odpowiedzi, dostarcza gotowe dokumenty, wiadomości na Slacku czy aktualizuje wpisy w kalendarzu.
data.translatedTitle: No more chatting with the bot. A renowned scientist is changing the way we interact with AI
data.translatedDescription: Prof. Andrew Ng presented OpenWorker, a tool that breaks with the current chatbot pattern. Instead of conducting conversations and providing text answers, it delivers ready-made documents, Slack messages or updates calendar entries.

data.title: Sposób parzenia kawy ma znaczenie. Polscy fizycy wyjaśnili zagadkę idealnego espresso
data.description: Polscy fizycy przyjrzeli się bliżej procesowi parzenia kawy. Jak się okazuje, ciśnienie w ekspresie może znacząco wpływać na smak i konsystencję porannego espresso. Z badań naukowców wynika, że wyższe ciśnienie zamiast zwiększać aromat kawy, czasem działa jak coraz mocniej zaciskany korek.
data.translatedTitle: How you brew coffee matters. Polish physicists have solved the mystery of the perfect espresso
data.translatedDescription: Polish physicists took a closer look at the coffee brewing process. As it turns out, the pressure in the espresso machine can significantly affect the taste and consistency of your morning espresso. Research by scientists shows that higher pressure, instead of increasing the aroma of coffee, sometimes acts like a cork being tightened more and more tightly.

data.title: Powrót rosyjskich siatkarzy a prawo. Czy wystąpią na mistrzostwach w Polsce?
data.description: Odpowiedź na pytanie, czy rosyjscy siatkarze zagrają w 2027 r. w Polsce nie jest jednoznaczna i wymagałaby oceny przepisów obowiązujących w chwili turnieju, indywidualnych podstaw wjazdu i ewentualnych wyjątków.
data.translatedTitle: The return of Russian volleyball players and the law. Will they perform at the championships in Poland?
data.translatedDescription: The answer to the question of whether Russian volleyball players will play in Poland in 2027 is not clear and would require an assessment of the regulations in force at the time of the tournament, individual grounds for entry and possible exceptions.

data.title: Flotę LOT-u zasilił nowy boeing 737 MAX 8. Do końca wakacji przylecą jeszcze dwa
data.description: Kolejny z zamówionych przez Polskie Linie Lotnicze LOT samolotów Boeing 737 MAX 8 przyleciał do Polski. Jak poinformował w sobotę rzecznik LOT-u Krzysztof Moczulski, to jedenasty z trzynastu zamówionych przez LOT samolotów tego typu.
data.translatedTitle: The LOT fleet has been joined by a new Boeing 737 MAX 8. Two more will arrive by the end of the summer
data.translatedDescription: Another Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft ordered by LOT Polish Airlines has arrived in Poland. As LOT spokesman Krzysztof Moczulski announced on Saturday, this is the eleventh of thirteen aircraft of this type ordered by LOT.

data.title: Pożary pustoszą Francję i Hiszpanię. Ewakuowano ponad ćwierć miliona osób
data.description: Blisko 270 tys. osób zostało ewakuowanych we Francji i Hiszpanii z terenów, które od kilku dni trawią pożary. Najpoważniejsza sytuacja panuje w departamencie Żyrondy na południu Francji i w okolicach stolicy Hiszpanii, Madrytu. W wyniku innego mniejszego pożaru nieopodal Walencji zginęła jedna osoba. Władze Francji ostrzegły, że sytuacja jest nadal poważna.
data.translatedTitle: Fires are devastating France and Spain. More than a quarter of a million people were evacuated
data.translatedDescription: Nearly 270 thousand people were evacuated in France and Spain from areas that have been ravaged by fires for several days. The situation is most serious in the Gironde department in the south of France and around the Spanish capital, Madrid. Another smaller fire near Valencia killed one person. French authorities warned that the situation remained serious.

data.title: Prezydent Kazachstanu apeluje do Putina. „Trzeba tej wojnie położyć kres”
data.description: Prezydent Kazachstanu Kasym-Żomart Tokajew zaapelował w sobotę do prezydenta Rosji Władimira Putina o zamrożenie wojny w Ukrainie. Przywódcy spotkali się na forum regionalnym w Omsku. - To musi się skończyć - powiedział Tokajew, wzywając do powrotu do negocjacji pokojowych.
data.translatedTitle: The president of Kazakhstan appeals to Putin. "We must put an end to this war"
data.translatedDescription: Kazakh President Kasym-Jomart Tokayev on Saturday appealed to Russian President Vladimir Putin to freeze the war in Ukraine. The leaders met at the regional forum in Omsk. "This must end," Tokayev said, calling for a return to peace negotiations.

data.title: Sześć tysięcy lat nieprzerwanego osadnictwa. Çadır Höyük odsłania historię życia w Anatolii
data.description: Archeolodzy prowadzący badania w Çadır Höyük w środkowej Turcji odtwarzają historię społeczności, które przez około 6000 lat nieprzerwanie zamieszkiwały to miejsce. Analizują, jak budowano domy, organizowano przestrzeń osady i wytwarzano ceramikę. Najnowsze wykopaliska koncentrują się na tradycjach architektonicznych, które – jak się okazuje – przetrwały do dziś w pobliskiej wsi.
data.translatedTitle: Six thousand years of continuous settlement. Çadır Höyük reveals the history of life in Anatolia
data.translatedDescription: Archaeologists conducting research in Çadır Höyük in central Turkey are reconstructing the history of the communities that continuously inhabited this place for approximately 6,000 years. They analyze how houses were built, the settlement space was organized and ceramics were produced. The latest excavations focus on architectural traditions that, as it turns out, have survived to this day in a nearby village.

data.title: Niemcy chcą podnieść wiek emerytalny. Rząd popiera reformę, związkowcy protestują
data.description: Kanclerz Niemiec Friedrich Merz zapowiedział, że przeforsuje proponowaną reformę systemu emerytalnego. Reforma miałaby obejmować stopniowe podnoszenie w przyszłości wieku emerytalnego powyżej 67 lat - w powiązaniu ze średnią długością życia.
data.translatedTitle: Germany wants to raise the retirement age. The government supports the reform, trade unionists protest
data.translatedDescription: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz announced that he would push through the proposed reform of the pension system. The reform would include a gradual increase in the future of the retirement age above 67 years - in connection with average life expectancy.

data.title: Po útoku na LGBT pochod v Berlíně policie zná podezřelého. Má vazby na islamisty
data.description: Německá policie pátrá po 21letém muži, kterého podezřívá ze sobotního útoku na akci na podporu práv komunity LGBT+ v Berlíně. Podle mluvčího hasičů při útoku zahynula jedna žena, 16 dalších lidí utrpělo zranění, z toho tři jsou v ohrožení života. Podle policie má podezřelý Abdul B. vazby na islamistickou scénu, motiv činu je ale nejasný. Policisté jej zatím vyšetřují jako úmyslný útok. Nevylučují, že měl Abdul B. komplice.
data.translatedTitle: After the attack on the LGBT march in Berlin, the police know the suspect. He has ties to Islamists
data.translatedDescription: German police are searching for a 21-year-old man they suspect of Saturday's attack on an event to support the rights of the LGBT+ community in Berlin. According to the spokesman of the fire department, one woman was killed in the attack, 16 other people were injured, three of which are in danger of life. According to the police, the suspect Abdul B. has ties to the Islamist scene, but the motive for the crime is unclear. The police are still investigating it as a deliberate attack. They do not rule out that Abdul B. had accomplices.

data.title: Počasí hraje proti hasičům. U Bordeaux evakuují dalších 55 tisíc lidí
data.description: Francouzská prefektura departementu Gironde v noci na dnešek nařídila evakuaci dalších 55 tisíc obyvatel z obcí v okolí Bordeaux. Důvodem je znovu rozhořelý rozsáhlý lesní požár, který oblast sužuje již od středy, uvedla prefektura. Jižně od Bordeaux byla navíc přerušena železniční doprava.
data.translatedTitle: The weather is playing against the firefighters. Another 55,000 people are being evacuated near Bordeaux
data.translatedDescription: The French prefecture of the Gironde department ordered the evacuation of another 55,000 residents from the municipalities around Bordeaux last night. The reason is the rekindling of a large forest fire that has been plaguing the area since Wednesday, the prefecture said. In addition, rail traffic was interrupted south of Bordeaux.

data.title: Na Klatovsku hoří les v prudkém kopci. Zkrocený požár hasiči hlídali i v noci
data.description: Požár lesa ve strmém kopci u Velhartic na Klatovsku je pod kontrolou. Plochu téměř pěti hektarů v sobotu večer dohašovali hasiči s vrtulníkem s bambivakem. Oheň v těžko přístupném terénu kontrolovali dobrovolní hasiči celou noc, řekl velitel zásahu Aleš Bucifal.
data.translatedTitle: A forest is burning on a steep hill in Klatovska. Firefighters watched over the tamed fire even at night
data.translatedDescription: The forest fire on the steep hill near Velhartice in Klatovsk is under control. An area of ​​almost five hectares was extinguished on Saturday evening by firefighters using a helicopter with a bambivac. The fire in the difficult-to-access terrain was controlled by volunteer firefighters all night, said the incident commander Aleš Bucifal.

data.title: Škoda Group hledá nové jméno a logo, to tradiční musí za tři roky opustit
data.description: Na jednu z nejvýznamnějších změn ve své téměř 170leté historii spojené s Plzní a průmyslníkem Emilem Škodou se chystá Škoda Group. Za tři roky skončí licence na značku Škoda a logo s okřídleným šípem. Ty skupina před časem prodala automobilce Škoda Auto, jejíž vozy je budou smět využívat výhradně už od července 2029.
data.translatedTitle: Škoda Group is looking for a new name and logo, the traditional one must be abandoned in three years
data.translatedDescription: Škoda Group is preparing for one of the most significant changes in its almost 170-year history associated with Pilsen and industrialist Emil Škoda. In three years, the license for the Škoda brand and the winged arrow logo will expire. Some time ago, the group sold them to Škoda Auto, whose cars will be allowed to use them exclusively from July 2029.

data.title: Muž na vozíku nestíhal přejet přes přechod. Na pomoc mu přišel Spider-Man
data.description: Těžko uvěřitelnou situaci zachytila dopravní kamera v americkém městě Jonesboro ve státě Arkansas., Když se muži na invalidním vozíku nedařilo přejet přes přechod pro chodce před čtyřmi pruhy čekajících aut, přišel mu na pomoc skutečný hrdina. Z jednoho auta najednou vyskočil Spider-Man.
data.translatedTitle: The man in the wheelchair did not have time to cross the crossing. Spider-Man came to his aid
data.translatedDescription: The hard-to-believe situation was caught by a traffic camera in the American city of Jonesboro, Arkansas. When a man in a wheelchair failed to cross a pedestrian crossing in front of four lanes of waiting cars, a real hero came to his aid. Spider-Man suddenly jumped out of one of the cars.

data.title: V první třídě neuměl anglicky, na střední ho nechtěli. Proč Pitbull založil vlastní školy?
data.description: Jako dítě kubánských emigrantů šel v Miami do školy, aniž by uměl anglicky. Když opouštěl střední školu, její ředitel mu doslova řekl, aby hlavně vypadnul. A v 16 letech ho matka vyhodila z domu. Přesto rapper Pitbull považuje školu a vzdělání za naprostou prioritu a založil dokonce svou síť škol.
data.translatedTitle: He didn't know English in first grade, they didn't want him in high school. Why did Pitbull start his own schools?
data.translatedDescription: A child of Cuban immigrants, he went to school in Miami without knowing English. When he was leaving high school, his principal literally told him to drop out. And at the age of 16, his mother threw him out of the house. Nevertheless, the rapper Pitbull considers school and education to be an absolute priority and even founded his network of schools.

data.title: Policie v Berlíně ukončila LGBT pochod. Do davu vjelo auto, jeden člověk zemřel
data.description: Berlínská policie v sobotu večer předčasně ukončila pochod za práva komunity LGBT+ nazvaný Christopher Street Day, a to několik hodin po jeho zahájení. Do účastníků najelo auto. Jeden člověk zahynul a nejméně dalších čtrnáct utrpělo zranění. Policie zahájila pátrání po možných pachatelích.
data.translatedTitle: Police in Berlin put an end to the LGBT march. A car drove into the crowd, one person died
data.translatedDescription: On Saturday night, the Christopher Street Day march for the rights of the LGBT+ community was brought to an early end by Berlin police, a few hours after it had started. A car ran into the participants. One person was killed and at least fourteen others were injured. The police have launched a search for possible perpetrators.

data.title: Našly se trosky letadla Pan Am z roku 1952. Havárie změnila bezpečnost letectví
data.description: Podmořský dron objevil trosky letadla společnosti Pan Am, které v roce 1952 ztroskotalo v oceánu nedaleko pobřeží Portorika. Letadlo typu Douglas DC-4 jménem Clipper Endeavor havarovalo poté, co mu krátce po vzletu selhaly dva motory. Při této nehodě nakonec zahynulo 52 lidí, třicet devět těl se nikdy nepodařilo najít. Katastrofa přispěla k zavedení předletových instruktáží o nouzových východech a záchranných vestách.
data.translatedTitle: Wreckage of 1952 Pan Am plane found. Crash changed aviation safety
data.translatedDescription: An underwater drone has discovered the wreckage of a Pan Am plane that crashed in the ocean off the coast of Puerto Rico in 1952. A Douglas DC-4 named Clipper Endeavor crashed after two engines failed shortly after takeoff. In the end, 52 people died in this accident, thirty-nine bodies were never found. The disaster contributed to the introduction of pre-flight briefings on emergency exits and life jackets.

data.title: Tyče u stanu či pohorky? Lidé chtějí do přírody bez utrpení, říká outdoor vývojář
data.description: Chtěl být strojvedoucím a řídit vlak. Nakonec to ale vzal objížďkou a zamířil k outdooru. Dnes Marek Šmakal ve firmě 4camping vyvíjí co nejlehčí batohy, co nejteplejší spacáky a co nejpohodlnější karimatky. V rozhovoru popisuje, jak se mění výbava do přírody, technologie i nároky zákazníků.
data.translatedTitle: Poles by the tent or mountain top? People want to go to nature without suffering, says an outdoor developer
data.translatedDescription: He wanted to be a train driver and drive a train. But in the end he took a detour and headed for the outdoor area. Today, Marek Šmakal at 4camping develops the lightest backpacks, the warmest sleeping bags and the most comfortable mats. In the interview, he describes how equipment changes to nature, technology and customer demands.

data.title: 500 let od nástupu Habsburků na český trůn. Jak se zapsali v Praze?
data.description: Letohrádek královny Anny, Colinovo mauzoleum či třeba Zlatá ulička. Ověřte si, jak dobře znáte tu část pražské historie, která je spjatá s Habsburky. Od jejich nástupu na český trůn uplynulo 500 let.
data.translatedTitle: 500 years since the accession of the Habsburgs to the Czech throne. How did they register in Prague?
data.translatedDescription: Queen Anne's summer house, Colin's mausoleum or perhaps Zlatá ulička. Check how well you know the part of Prague's history that is connected with the Habsburgs. 500 years have passed since their accession to the Czech throne.

data.title: Na lodě uvázali kozy a odpálili atomovku. Pentagon z výbuchu na Bikini udělal show
data.description: Druhá světová válka sice skončila, jaderné zbrojení se však rozjelo naplno. Američané si své zbraně zkázy otestovali v tichomořském ráji, který ale svět zná především díky dvoudílným plavkám. Osmdesát let od operace Crossroads si připomeňte v dalším díle seriálu Slavné fotografie.
data.translatedTitle: They tied goats to ships and detonated a nuclear weapon. The Pentagon made a show out of the Bikini explosion
data.translatedDescription: The Second World War may have ended, but nuclear weapons were in full swing. The Americans tested their weapons of destruction in the Pacific paradise, which the world knows mainly thanks to two-piece swimsuits. Remember eighty years since Operation Crossroads in the next installment of the Famous Photos series.

data.title: Největší hrozbou AI nemusí být smrtící roboti. V ohrožení je výběr daní
data.description: Umělá inteligence může během několika let zásadně proměnit světovou ekonomiku. Největším problémem přitom nemusí být ani ztráta pracovních míst, ani obávaní roboti-zabijáci. Podle odborníků se vlády mohou potýkat s mnohem zásadnější hrozbou: pokud AI nahradí velkou část lidské práce, začnou se jim propadat daňové příjmy.
data.translatedTitle: The biggest threat to AI may not be deadly robots. Tax collection is at risk
data.translatedDescription: Artificial intelligence can fundamentally transform the world economy within a few years. The biggest problem may not be the loss of jobs or the dreaded killer robots. According to experts, governments may face a much more fundamental threat: if AI replaces much of human labor, they will start losing tax revenue.

data.title: Opalování na ropných skvrnách, rakety na pláži. Dovolená na Krymu Rusům zhořkla
data.description: Válka jim vadí kvůli diskomfortu na dovolené. Někteří Rusové ale přes složitou cestu a s raketami nad hlavou do černomořských letovisek přesto jedou. „Začíná to být tak otravné, nenechají nás si odpočinout,“ vzdychají nad situací.
data.translatedTitle: Sunbathing on oil spills, rockets on the beach. Vacation in Crimea turned sour for Russians
data.translatedDescription: War bothers them because of the discomfort on vacation. However, some Russians still go to the Black Sea resorts through a difficult route and with rockets above their heads. "It's getting so annoying, they won't let us rest," they sigh about the situation.

data.title: Nejhorší scénář? Experti popisují, jak by vypadala totální válka Hradu s vládou
data.description: Po prezidentově vetu zákona o rozpočtové odpovědnosti se konflikt mezi Petrem Pavlem a vládou Andreje Babiše nadále eskaluje a nic nenasvědčuje tomu, že by se měla situace v dohledné době zklidnit. Redakce iDNES.cz se proto u politologů a ústavních právníků zajímala, jak by podle nich mohl vypadat nejhorší scénář totální války mezi prezidentem a vládou.
data.translatedTitle: Worst case scenario? Experts describe what a total war between the Castle and the government would look like
data.translatedDescription: After the President's veto of the Budget Responsibility Act, the conflict between Petr Pavlo and the government of Andrej Babiš continues to escalate, and there is no indication that the situation should calm down in the foreseeable future. The editors of iDNES.cz therefore asked political scientists and constitutional lawyers what they thought the worst scenario of a total war between the president and the government might look like.

data.title: Auto najelo do lidí na Christopher Street Day v Berlíně, jeden mrtvý a 14 zraněných
data.description: Při večerní akci na podporu práv LGBT+ Christopher Street Day v Berlíně najelo auto do lidí, jeden člověk zemřel a nejméně 14 dalších utrpělo zranění, policie po možných pachatelích pátrá.
data.translatedTitle: A car plowed into people on Christopher Street Day in Berlin, killing one and injuring 14
data.translatedDescription: At the Christopher Street Day LGBT+ rights event in Berlin, a car drove into people, one person died and at least 14 others were injured, the police are looking for possible perpetrators.

data.title: Rusko verbuje desítky tisíc severokorejských vojáků, varuje Zelenskyj
data.description: Rusko chce podle ukrajinského prezidenta Volodymyra Zelenského získat ze Severní Koreje až 30 tisíc vojáků k nasazení ve válce proti Ukrajině. Zelenskyj to řekl v pravidelném večerním proslovu. KLDR se také podle něj chystá předat Rusku další zařízení pro odpalování balistických raket.
data.translatedTitle: Russia is recruiting tens of thousands of North Korean soldiers, Zelensky warns
data.translatedDescription: According to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, Russia wants to get up to 30,000 soldiers from North Korea to deploy in the war against Ukraine. Zelensky said this in a regular evening speech. According to him, the DPRK is also preparing to hand over another device for launching ballistic missiles to Russia.

data.title: Demokraté mají nového kandidáta. Do senátního boje půjde bývalý dřevorubec
data.description: Dvoutýdenní boj o uvolněné místo kandidáta do amerického Senátu ve státě Maine je u konce. Demokraté v sobotu vybrali na narychlo svolaném sjezdu v Bangoru bývalého dřevorubce Troye Jacksona. Nahradil tak kontroverzního válečného veterána Grahama Platnera, který na začátku července kampaň ukončil kvůli skandálům včetně obvinění ze znásilnění.
data.translatedTitle: The Democrats have a new candidate. A former lumberjack will enter the Senate fight
data.translatedDescription: The two-week battle for the vacant seat of a candidate for the US Senate in the state of Maine is over. Democrats picked ex-logger Troy Jackson at a hastily called convention in Bangor on Saturday. He thus replaced the controversial war veteran Graham Platner, who ended the campaign in early July due to scandals including allegations of rape.

data.title: Tříleté dítě vypadlo z okna ve čtvrtém patře, holčičku převážel vrtulník
data.description: Neštěstí se v sobotu v podvečer stalo v havířovské části Šumbark. Z okna bytu ve čtvrtém patře panelového domu vypadla tříletá dívenka, zraněnou ji převážel záchranářský vrtulník. Ve městě jde o třetí pád dítěte z výšky za dva měsíce.
data.translatedTitle: A three-year-old child fell out of a window on the fourth floor, the girl was being transported by helicopter
data.translatedDescription: The accident happened in the Havířov part of Šumbark in the early evening on Saturday. A three-year-old girl fell out of the window of an apartment on the fourth floor of a block of flats. She was transported injured by a rescue helicopter. In the city, this is the third fall of a child from a height in two months.

data.title: Neexistuje větší ani menší trauma. V Izraeli to platí dvojnásob, líčí psycholožka
data.description: Strach, pláč, zmar, houkající sirény, to je Izrael. Tamním lidem, kterým se 7. října 2023 rozpadl celý svět, patří unikátní projekt. Do Prahy přijíždějí páry z nejhůř zasažených osad, aby zde našly ztracenou rovnováhu. Psycholožka Linda Arbeli vypráví o emotivních terapeutických sezeních či o obavách Izraelců cestovat do evropských metropolí. Proč naopak v Praze strach necítí?
data.translatedTitle: There is no greater or lesser trauma. This is doubly true in Israel, the psychologist explains
data.translatedDescription: Fear, crying, destruction, blaring sirens, this is Israel. A unique project belongs to the people there, whose whole world fell apart on October 7, 2023. Couples from the worst affected settlements come to Prague to find their lost balance. Psychologist Linda Arbeli talks about emotional therapy sessions and the fears of Israelis traveling to European capitals. Why, on the other hand, does he feel no fear in Prague?

data.title: Benzin se nebude z Ruska vyvážet až do konce roku, oznámil vicepremiér
data.description: Zákaz vývozu benzinu z Ruska bude platit do konce letošního roku, oznámil místopředseda ruské vlády Alexandr Novak. Ruské úřady se musely k různým opatřením na podporu domácího trhu uchýlit poté, co ukrajinské dronové útoky na rafinerie způsobily nedostatek pohonných hmot a přispěly k růstu cen.
data.translatedTitle: Gasoline will not be exported from Russia until the end of the year, the Deputy Prime Minister announced
data.translatedDescription: The ban on the export of gasoline from Russia will be in effect until the end of this year, announced the Deputy Prime Minister of Russia, Alexander Novak. Russian authorities have had to resort to various measures to support the domestic market after Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries caused fuel shortages and contributed to rising prices.

data.title: Hrotovice otevřely kulturní dům za 140 milionů. Přijet chce i Tublatanka
data.description: Osmnáct set obyvatel a stavba za sto čtyřicet milionů korun. Když se malé městečko pustí do projektu, o kterém si větší sousedé mohou nechat jen zdát, bývá to buď neuvážený hazard, nebo splněný sen. V Hrotovicích v sobotu platilo to druhé.
data.translatedTitle: Hrotovice opened a cultural center for 140 million. Tublatanka also wants to come
data.translatedDescription: Eighteen hundred inhabitants and a building for one hundred and forty million crowns. When a small town embarks on a project that its larger neighbors can only dream of, it's either an ill-advised gamble or a dream come true. The latter was the case in Hrotovice on Saturday.

data.title: Jelen v Beskydech přeskakoval motorkáře. Střet nepřežili jezdec ani zvíře
data.description: Jednasedmdesátiletý motorkář zemřel v sobotu po střetu s jelenem v Bílé na Frýdecko-Místecku. Silnice I/35 musela být po nehodě zhruba dvě hodiny částečně uzavřená a policisté odkláněli dopravu.
data.translatedTitle: A deer was jumping over motorcyclists in the Beskydy Mountains. Neither rider nor animal survived the collision
data.translatedDescription: A 71-year-old motorcyclist died on Saturday after a collision with a deer in Bílá in Frýdecko-Místek. The I/35 road had to be partially closed for about two hours after the accident, and the police diverted traffic.

data.title: Dojemný moment, líčil Malátný na Benátské po koncertě se synem zesnulého bubeníka
data.description: Lídr skupiny Chinaski Michal Malátný zavzpomínal v rámci Benátské s Impulsem na zakládajícího člena Pavla Grohmana, který tragicky zahynul při dopravní nehodě. „Na koncertě s námi bubnoval jeho syn, byl to dojemný moment,“ líčil po vystoupení.
data.translatedTitle: A touching moment, Malátný described in Venátská after a concert with the late drummer's son
data.translatedDescription: The leader of the Chinaski group, Michal Malátný, remembered founding member Pavel Grohman, who tragically died in a traffic accident, as part of Venátská s Impulso. "His son played drums with us at the concert, it was a touching moment," he recounted after the performance.

data.title: Kufr plný vzpomínek. Jeho majitel se tři roky skrýval, blízké mu vzala heydrichiáda
data.description: Když v létě 1942 utíkal před gestapem, zanechal František Hovora na pardubickém nádraží kufr s fotografiemi, osobními věcmi a vzpomínkami na svůj dosavadní život. Sám se pak téměř tři roky skrýval v ilegalitě. Když se po osvobození vrátil, kufr na něj stále čekal. Jeho rodina a řada přátel, kteří se stali oběťmi heydrichiády, už ne. Příběh Hovory vypráví text ve spolupráci s Pamětí národa.
data.translatedTitle: A suitcase full of memories. Its owner hid for three years, his loved ones were taken by the Heydrich
data.translatedDescription: When František Hovora was fleeing from the Gestapo in the summer of 1942, he left a suitcase with photographs, personal belongings and memories of his life so far at the Pardubice railway station. He then hid himself underground for almost three years. When he returned after his liberation, the suitcase was still waiting for him. His family and a number of friends who fell victim to the heydrichiad no longer. The story of Conversations is told by a text in cooperation with the Memory of the Nation.

data.title: Kriminalisté obvinili ženu z vraždy v Jablonci nad Nisou. Soud ji poslal do vazby
data.description: Z vraždy, která se stala ve čtvrtek odpoledne v jednom z bytových domů v Jablonci nad Nisou, kriminalisté obvinili pětatřicetiletou ženu. Soudce Okresního soudu ženu v sobotu poslal do vazby, uvedla policie odpoledne na síti X.
data.translatedTitle: Criminal investigators accused a woman of murder in Jablonec nad Nisou. The court sent her to custody
data.translatedDescription: Detectives charged a thirty-five-year-old woman with the murder, which happened on Thursday afternoon in one of the apartment buildings in Jablonec nad Nisou. The judge of the District Court sent the woman into custody on Saturday, the police said in the afternoon on the X network.

data.title: „Miluju, jak Koller píše.“ Světový producent Lyon přiletěl na Benátskou vrtulníkem
data.description: Spolupracoval s kapelami Depeche Mode nebo The Cure, nyní připravuje novou desku s Davidem Kollerem. A právě díky němu zažil britský producent Steve Lyon jeden z historicky nejefektnějších příchodů, respektive příletů na festival Benátská! s Impulsem. Místo dodávky dorazili v pátek do Liberce vrtulníkem.
data.translatedTitle: "I love the way Koller writes." World producer Lyon arrived in Venice by helicopter
data.translatedDescription: He has collaborated with the bands Depeche Mode and The Cure, and is now preparing a new record with David Koller. And it was thanks to him that the British producer Steve Lyon experienced one of the most spectacular arrivals in the history of the Venice festival! with Impulse. Instead of delivery, they arrived in Liberec by helicopter on Friday.

data.title: KOMENTÁŘ: Příběh dálnice D35 za stovky miliard otestuje kvalitu výběrových řízení
data.description: Bude to jedna z největších dopravních zakázek v historii České republiky. Dostavba úseku strategicky velice důležité dálnice D35 mezi Opatovcem a Mohelnicí se připravuje jako projekt veřejně-soukromého partnerství (PPP), který bude historicky největší. Čísly 1,7 miliard eur. A nepůjde jen o cenu stavby v náročném terénu se čtyřkilometrovým tunelem. Roli v takto velkém tendru totiž sehrají i další významné faktory.
data.translatedTitle: COMMENTARY: The story of the D35 motorway worth hundreds of billions will test the quality of tenders
data.translatedDescription: It will be one of the largest transport orders in the history of the Czech Republic. The completion of the section of the strategically important D35 highway between Opatovec and Mohelnica is being prepared as a public-private partnership (PPP) project, which will be the largest in history. Figures 1.7 billion euros. And it will not only be about the cost of construction in difficult terrain with a four-kilometer tunnel. Other important factors will also play a role in such a large tender.

data.title: Neskutečně mě baví pracovat s mladými koňmi, říká chovatel a majitel závodiště
data.description: Jeden z životních úspěchů nedávno zaznamenal Jiří Svoboda, chovatel klusáckých koní a majitel závodiště v Bravanticích na Novojičínsku. Devítiletá klisna Hannah z jeho chovu připravovaná ve Francii se v dostihu na švédském závodišti Solvalla u Stockholmu stala spoludržitelkou světového rekordu.
data.translatedTitle: I really enjoy working with young horses, says the breeder and owner of the racecourse
data.translatedDescription: Jiří Svoboda, breeder of trotting horses and owner of the racetrack in Bravantice in Novojičín region, recently recorded one of his life's successes. The nine-year-old mare Hannah from his breeding, prepared in France, became co-holder of the world record in a race at the Swedish Solvalla racecourse near Stockholm.

data.title: Požár v dětském táboře. Hasiči evakuovali přes 70 lidí, škoda dosahuje 900 tisíc
data.description: U Otročiněvsi na Berounsku dopoledne hořelo v areálu dětského tábora. Oheň zachvátil dřevěný srub, přístřešek a část lesa. Hasiči evakuovali 40 dětí a 31 dospělých, jeden člověk se nadýchal zplodin. Plameny napáchaly škodu za 900 tisíc korun, příčinou byla technická závada na komínu.
data.translatedTitle: A fire in a children's camp. Firefighters evacuated over 70 people, the damage amounts to 900,000
data.translatedDescription: There was a fire in the area of ​​the children's camp near Otročiněvsi in Berounsk this morning. The fire engulfed a wooden log cabin, a shed and part of the forest. Firefighters evacuated 40 children and 31 adults, one person inhaled fumes. The flames caused 900,000 crowns in damage, the cause being a technical fault with the chimney.

data.title: Umělecká hravost. Na Pop Messe vystoupí Einstürzende Neubauten či Richard Müller
data.description: Ve dnech 6. až 8. srpna se v areálu brněnského velodromu uskuteční sedmý ročník festivalu Pop Messe. Mezi hlavní hvězdy letošního programu patří Oklou, Einstürzende Neubauten, Richard Müller nebo Overmono. Vystoupí také Gufrau, Anna von Hausswolff, Bratři a řada dalších interpretů.
data.translatedTitle: Artistic playfulness. Einstürzende Neubauten and Richard Müller will perform at Pop Messe
data.translatedDescription: The seventh edition of the Pop Messe festival will take place on the grounds of the Brno velodrome from August 6 to 8. Among the main stars of this year's program are Oklou, Einstürzende Neubauten, Richard Müller and Overmono. Gufrau, Anna von Hausswolff, Bratři and many other performers will also perform.

data.title: Portugal sagra-se tricampeão europeu masculino de hóquei em patins de sub-17
data.description: A seleção portuguesa masculina de hóquei em patins de sub-17 sagrou-se hoje tricampeã europeia da categoria, ao vencer a Espanha (3-2), recordista de títulos, na final disputada em Braga.
data.translatedTitle: Portugal becomes three-time European men's under-17 roller hockey champion
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese men's under-17 roller hockey team became three-time European champions in the category today, beating Spain (3-2), the record holder for titles, in the final held in Braga.

data.title: Alexander Blockx vence Luciano Darderi e está na final
data.description: O tenista belga Alexander Blockx, quarto cabeça de série, qualificou-se hoje para a final do Estoril Open, depois de vencer o italiano Luciano Darderi, segundo pré-designado.
data.translatedTitle: Alexander Blockx beats Luciano Darderi and is in the final
data.translatedDescription: Belgian tennis player Alexander Blockx, fourth seed, qualified today for the Estoril Open final, after beating Italian Luciano Darderi, second seed.

data.title: Um morto e vários feridos em atropelamento numa Marcha do Orgulho LGBTI+ em Berlim
data.description: Um morto e 15 feridos é para já o resultado de um incidente com um veículo no parque Tiergarten, em Berlim, onde terminava hoje à noite a Marcha do Orgulho LGBTI+. A polícia local está a mencionar um possível atropelamento.
data.translatedTitle: One dead and several injured in run-over at LGBTI+ Pride Parade in Berlin
data.translatedDescription: One death and 15 injuries are now the result of an incident with a vehicle in Tiergarten park, in Berlin, where the LGBTI+ Pride March ended tonight. Local police are mentioning a possible hit-and-run.

data.title: Regressado Nelson Évora domina triplo
data.description: Pouco mais de um mês depois de ter regressado à competição, findando três épocas de ausência, Nelson Évora (Juventude Ilha Verde), de 42 anos, dominou o triplo salto, ao rubricar 16,03 metros no terceiro ensaio, e deixou Tiago Luís Pereira, heptacampeão em título, no segundo lugar, com 15,93.
data.translatedTitle: Returned Nelson Évora dominates triple
data.translatedDescription: Just over a month after returning to the competition, after three seasons of absence, Nelson Évora (Juventude Ilha Verde), aged 42, dominated the triple jump, reaching 16.03 meters in the third test, and leaving Tiago Luís Pereira, seven-time defending champion, in second place, with 15.93.

data.title: Hat-trick’ de Francisco Silva na goleada do Benfica B aos espanhóis do Mérida
data.description: O Benfica B, da II Liga portuguesa de futebol, goleou hoje por 4-0 o Mérida, do terceiro escalão de Espanha, em jogo de preparação para a época 2026/27, disputado no Benfica Campus, no Seixal.
data.translatedTitle: Francisco Silva's hat-trick in Benfica B's defeat of Spanish side Mérida
data.translatedDescription: Benfica B, from the II Portuguese Football League, today beat Mérida, from Spain's third tier, 4-0, in a preparatory game for the 2026/27 season, played at the Benfica Campus, in Seixal.

data.title: FC Porto vence Aston Villa no jogo de apresentação aos sócios
data.description: O FC Porto venceu hoje os ingleses do Aston Villa, por 2-1, em jogo de preparação que serviu de apresentação do plantel de futebol dos campeões nacionais para a temporada 2026/27, no Estádio do Dragão.
data.translatedTitle: FC Porto beats Aston Villa in the presentation game to members
data.translatedDescription: FC Porto today beat the English side Aston Villa, 2-1, in a preparatory game that served as a presentation of the national champions' football squad for the 2026/27 season, at Estádio do Dragão.

data.title: Marítimo empata sem golos com AD Machico em encontro particular
data.description: O Marítimo empatou hoje 0-0 com a AD Machico, do Campeonato de Portugal, em jogo de preparação disputado à porta fechada, no recinto do emblema campeão da II Liga e recém-promovido ao primeiro escalão.
data.translatedTitle: Marítimo draws goalless with AD Machico in a private meeting
data.translatedDescription: Marítimo drew 0-0 today with AD Machico, from the Portuguese Championship, in a preparatory game played behind closed doors, at the stadium of the champion of the II League and recently promoted to the first division.

data.title: Três homens detidos em França por provocar fogo posto
data.description: Três homens foram detidos hoje sob acusações relacionadas com a provocação de incêndios na região de Gironda, em França, onde se combate um incêndio de grandes proporções que já devastou 32.700 hectares e obrigou a retirar 167 mil pessoas.
data.translatedTitle: Three men arrested in France for causing arson
data.translatedDescription: Three men were arrested today on charges related to causing fires in the Gironde region, in France, where a huge fire is being fought that has already devastated 32,700 hectares and forced the evacuation of 167,000 people.

data.title: Sporting vence Mónaco e conquista Troféu Cinco Violinos
data.description: O Sporting venceu hoje o Troféu Cinco Violinos, ao bater o Mónaco por 2-0, no encontro que serviu de apresentação do plantel de futebol dos `leões` para a temporada 2026/27, no Estádio José Alvalade.
data.translatedTitle: Sporting beats Monaco and wins the Cinco Violinos Trophy
data.translatedDescription: Sporting won the Cinco Violinos Trophy today, beating Monaco 2-0, in the meeting that served as the presentation of the 'lions' football squad for the 2026/27 season, at the José Alvalade Stadium.

data.title: Casa Pia garante empréstimo do médio Selvi Clua
data.description: O Casa Pia garantiu o empréstimo do médio defensivo Selvi Clua junto do Almería, que milita na segunda divisão espanhola, anunciou hoje o clube da I Liga portuguesa de futebol.
data.translatedTitle: Casa Pia guarantees loan for midfielder Selvi Clua
data.translatedDescription: Casa Pia guaranteed the loan of midfielder Selvi Clua from Almería, which plays in the Spanish second division, the Portuguese football I League club announced today.

data.title: Académico de Viseu e Casa Pia empatam em jogo de preparação
data.description: Académico de Viseu e Casa Pia empataram hoje 1-1, no Estádio do Fontelo, em Viseu, em jogo de preparação das duas equipas da I Liga portuguesa de futebol para a época 2026/27.
data.translatedTitle: Académico de Viseu and Casa Pia draw in preparation game
data.translatedDescription: Académico de Viseu and Casa Pia drew 1-1 today, at Estádio do Fontelo, in Viseu, in a preparation game between the two teams from the Portuguese First League of football for the 2026/27 season.

data.title: Portugal perde com Espanha na final do Europeu feminino sub-17 de hóquei em patins
data.description: A seleção portuguesa feminina de hóquei em patins de sub-17 falhou hoje a reconquista do título europeu da categoria, ao perder na final com a Espanha (3-0), que se sagrou campeã pela terceira vez consecutiva, em Braga.
data.translatedTitle: Portugal loses to Spain in the European women's under-17 roller hockey final
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese women's under-17 roller hockey team failed today to regain the European category title, losing in the final to Spain (3-0), which became champions for the third consecutive time, in Braga.

data.title: Estoril Open. Van Assche não contava ir à final, mas não está surpreendido
data.description: O tenista francês Luca Van Assche não contava alcançar a sua primeira final no circuito ATP no Estoril Open no início da semana, mas, após vencer o compatriota Hugo Gaston, já não está “tão surpreendido”.
data.translatedTitle: Estoril Open. Van Assche didn't expect to reach the final, but he's not surprised
data.translatedDescription: French tennis player Luca Van Assche did not expect to reach his first final on the ATP circuit at the Estoril Open at the beginning of the week, but, after beating compatriot Hugo Gaston, he is no longer “so surprised”.

data.title: Alverca vence Farense com `bis` de Chiquinho em jogo de preparação
data.description: O Alverca, da I Liga portuguesa de futebol, venceu hoje por 2-0 o Farense, da II Liga, com dois golos de Chiquinho, num jogo de pré-temporada disputado à porta fechada, em Palmela, informou o clube ribatejano.
data.translatedTitle: Alverca beats Farense with Chiquinho's brace in preparation game
data.translatedDescription: Alverca, from the Portuguese football I League, beat Farense, from the II Liga, 2-0 today, with two goals from Chiquinho, in a pre-season game played behind closed doors, in Palmela, the Ribatejo club reported.

data.title: Vasco Vilaça é segundo em Londres e mantém liderança no Mundial de triatlo
data.description: O português Vasco Vilaça foi hoje segundo classificado na sexta etapa do Mundial de triatlo, disputada em Londres, mantendo a liderança no circuito quando faltam disputar três etapas.
data.translatedTitle: Vasco Vilaça is second in London and maintains leadership in the triathlon World Championship
data.translatedDescription: The Portuguese Vasco Vilaça was today second in the sixth stage of the Triathlon World Cup, held in London, maintaining his lead on the circuit with three stages remaining.

data.title: Famalicão vence Tondela por 1-0 antes da participação na Como Cup
data.description: O Famalicão venceu hoje o Tondela, da II Liga portuguesa de futebol, por 1-0, num jogo particular de preparação disputado no Minho, graças a um golo de Pedro Santos.
data.translatedTitle: Famalicão beats Tondela 1-0 before participating in the Como Cup
data.translatedDescription: Famalicão today beat Tondela, from the II Portuguese Football League, 1-0, in a friendly match played in Minho, thanks to a goal from Pedro Santos.

data.description: O avanço das chamas obrigou já à retirada de pelo menos 167.000 pessoas em Girona, França, com 32.700 hectares destruídos até agora. Em Landes, mais a sul, foram retiradas mais 31.000 pessoas, tendo ardido 3.500 hectares. Em Espanha, os incêndios de Madrid e de Ávila levaram as autoridades a retirar 60.000 pessoas, com outras 28.000 confinadas em casa.
data.translatedTitle: Almost 260,000 people evacuated from their homes due to fires in Spain and France
data.translatedDescription: The advance of the flames has already forced the evacuation of at least 167,000 people in Girona, France, with 32,700 hectares destroyed so far. In Landes, further south, a further 31,000 people were evacuated, burning 3,500 hectares. In Spain, the fires in Madrid and Ávila led authorities to evacuate 60,000 people, with another 28,000 confined to their homes.

data.title: Saudi inflation remains contained at 1.8% in May: GASTAT
data.description:
RIYADH: Saudi Arabia’s annual inflation rate edged up to 1.8 percent in May with housing rents continuing to drive price gains in the Kingdom, official data showed. 

	According to the latest report released by the General Authority for Statistics, the Kingdom’s Consumer Price Index edged up 0.2 percent month on month in May, reflecting moderate increases across several categories, including food, housing and transportation.

data.title: Israel says won’t withdraw troops from Lebanon, Syria, Gaza
data.description:
JERUSALEM: Israel’s defense minister said Monday that Israeli forces would remain in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza indefinitely, hours after the United States and Iran agreed to end the Middle East war, including in Lebanon.
	“Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and I are pursuing a clear policy under which the IDF will remain in the security zones in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza for an unlimited period of time, in order to protect the border and Israeli communities from there against jihadist elements,” Israel Katz said in a statement.

data.title: Lebanon warns displaced against rushing home after US-Iran deal
data.description:
BEIRUT/JERUSALEM: Authorities in southern Lebanon warned people displaced by three months of war between Israel and Hezbollah against rushing home on Monday despite a US-Iran deal to end the wider conflict, as Israel said it would not withdraw troops from the south.

	The warning comes as Lebanon has not been informed of details of the US-Iran agreement, an official source told AFP on Monday.

	“Lebanon was not informed of the terms of the agreement or the time of the ceasefire,” the source said on condition of anonymity.

data.title: Norway crown princess’s son sentenced to four years in prison for rape: court
data.description:
OSLO: An Oslo court on Monday convicted Norwegian Crown Princess Mette-Marit’s son of two counts of rape, sentencing him to four years in prison in a high-profile scandal that has rocked the monarchy.
	Marius Borg Hoiby, 29, Mette-Marit’s son from a relationship prior to her 2001 marriage to Crown Prince Haakon, was accused of 40 charges, carrying a maximum possible sentence of 16 years in prison.
	He was acquitted of two other counts of rape and convicted of domestic abuse against an ex-girlfriend, issuing threats and traffic violations.

data.title: Oil hits 3-month low as US, Iran reach peace deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
data.description:
SINGAPORE: Oil prices ​slipped to a three-month low on Monday after US President Donald Trump and Iran's deputy foreign minister said ‌they had reached an initial deal to end the war and to resume traffic through the Strait of Hormuz.

	Brent crude futures fell $3.65, or 4.2 percent, to $83.68 a barrel by 09:30 a.m. and US West Texas Intermediate was at $80.75, down $4.13, or 4.9 percent. Both contracts fell to their lowest ​levels since March 10 on Monday after tumbling more than 3 percent on Friday.

data.title: Ahead of the Egypt–Belgium match, ambassadors exchange national team jerseys
data.description:
CAIRO: Ahead of Egypt’s World Cup clash in Seattle against Belgium on Monday in the opening match of Group G, the ambassadors of the two nations have exchanged team shirts as a sign of their “strong friendship.”

	The two nations have never met at the World Cup, but have faced each other in four friendly matches, with Egypt winning three.

	Several Egyptian players have played in Belgium, including Ahmed Hossam “Mido” at Gent, and former national team captain Ahmed Hassan and Mahmoud Trezeguet at R.S.C. Anderlecht.

data.title: Poder Judicial declara "inejecutable" fallo del Tribunal Constitucional que anuló la prisión preventiva de Vladimir Cerrón
data.description: El juez Leodan Cristóbal Ayala señaló que la sentencia del Tribunal Constitucional no puede ejecutarse porque aún permanecen vigentes dos resoluciones judiciales que sustentan la prisión preventiva de Vladimir Cerrón. Por ello, solicitó al máximo intérprete de la Constitución que precise si los efectos de su fallo también alcanzan a dichas decisiones.
data.translatedTitle: Judiciary declares "unenforceable" ruling of the Constitutional Court that annulled the preventive detention of Vladimir Cerrón
data.translatedDescription: Judge Leodan Cristóbal Ayala pointed out that the ruling of the Constitutional Court cannot be executed because two judicial resolutions that support the preventive detention of Vladimir Cerrón are still in force. For this reason, he asked the highest interpreter of the Constitution to specify whether the effects of his ruling also reach said decisions.

data.title: LEÇONS DES DUNES : CE QUE LE BURUNDI DOIT RETENIR DU PARCOURS DES FENNECS AU MONDIAL 2026
data.description:
Le Mondial 2026 a refermé ses rideaux. Les Fennecs d'Algérie sont rentrés au bercail, non pas en conquérants, mais en soldats qui ont goûté à la fois au miel de la victoire et à l’amertume de l’élimination. 
 Et au loin, dans les collines du Burundi, on écoute. Car le destin a voulu que les Intamba Mu Rugamba croisent à nouveau la route des Fennecs. Groupe I des éliminatoires de la CAN 2027. Avec eux, la Zambie et le Togo. 
 La question n’est donc pas anodine : que faire de ce miroir algérien ? Faut-il fixer les yeux uniquement sur Alger, ou garder le regard large sur Lusaka et Lomé ?
data.translatedTitle: LESSONS FROM THE DUNES: WHAT BURUNDI SHOULD REMEMBER FROM THE FENNECS’ JOURNEY TO THE 2026 WORLD
data.translatedDescription:
The 2026 World Cup has closed its curtains. The Fennecs of Algeria returned home, not as conquerors, but as soldiers who tasted both the honey of victory and the bitterness of elimination. 
 And far away, in the hills of Burundi, we listen. Because destiny wanted the Intamba Mu Rugamba to cross paths with the Fennecs again. Group I of the CAN 2027 qualifiers. With them, Zambia and Togo. 
 The question is therefore not trivial: what to do with this Algerian mirror? Should we focus our eyes only on Algiers, or keep our eyes wide on Lusaka and Lomé?

data.title: L’Union des footballeurs du Congo met l’accent sur la protection et le bien-être des joueurs
data.description: L’Union des footballeurs du Congo (UFC) a tenu son assemblée générale ordinaire, jeudi 23 juillet à Kinshasa. Les participants ont évalué plusieurs projets visant à améliorer les conditions de vie et de travail des joueurs et joueuses de football en République démocratique du Congo. L’assemblée a également abordé la lutte contre la pédocriminalité et les violences dans le milieu sportif.
data.translatedTitle: The Union of Congo Footballers emphasizes the protection and well-being of players
data.translatedDescription: The Union of Congo Footballers (UFC) held its ordinary general assembly on Thursday July 23 in Kinshasa. Participants evaluated several projects aimed at improving the living and working conditions of football players in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The assembly also addressed the fight against child crime and violence in the sporting environment.

data.title: Au moins 32 civils tués en 72 heures dans des attaques attribuées aux ADF à Mambasa
data.description: La situation sécuritaire continue de se détériorer dans le territoire de Mambasa, en province de l'Ituri, où au moins 32 civils ont été tués et plusieurs autres enlevés au cours des 72 dernières heures lors de deux attaques attribuées aux rebelles des Forces démocratiques alliées (ADF) dans les localités de Njiapanda-Bela et Lukaya.
data.translatedTitle: At least 32 civilians killed in 72 hours in attacks attributed to the ADF in Mambasa
data.translatedDescription: The security situation continues to deteriorate in the territory of Mambasa, in the province of Ituri, where at least 32 civilians were killed and several others kidnapped over the last 72 hours during two attacks attributed to rebels of the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) in the localities of Njiapanda-Bela and Lukaya.

data.title: Tragédie familiale derrière une crise sanitaire : des enfants guéris d’Ebola, mais devenus orphelins
data.description: Derrière les chiffres de l’épidémie d’Ebola en Ituri se cachent des histoires humaines bouleversantes. Dans la zone de santé de Mongwalu, au nord de Bunia, plusieurs enfants ont survécu au virus, mais au prix d’une tragédie familiale : la perte de leurs deux parents emportés par Ebola.
data.translatedTitle: Family tragedy behind a health crisis: children cured of Ebola, but become orphans
data.translatedDescription: Behind the figures of the Ebola epidemic in Ituri lie moving human stories. In the Mongwalu health zone, north of Bunia, several children survived the virus, but at the cost of a family tragedy: the loss of both their parents to Ebola.

data.title: Fusillade à bord d’un bateau sur le lac Kivu : un mort et trois blessés
data.description: Une fusillade survenue à bord du bateau La Manne du Ciel, qui assurait la liaison entre Goma (Nord-Kivu) et Bukavu (Sud-Kivu), a semé la panique parmi les passagers à l’aube de ce samedi 25 juillet. Selon un bilan provisoire, une personne a été tuée et trois autres blessées. Les circonstances exactes du drame font actuellement l’objet d’enquêtes.
data.translatedTitle: Shooting aboard a boat on Lake Kivu: one dead and three injured
data.translatedDescription: A shooting that occurred on board the boat La Manne du Ciel, which operated between Goma (North Kivu) and Bukavu (South Kivu), sowed panic among passengers at dawn on Saturday July 25. According to a provisional report, one person was killed and three others injured. The exact circumstances of the tragedy are currently under investigation.

data.title: Mbuji-Mayi : la rareté des feuilles de manioc fait grimper les prix sur les marchés
data.description: À Mbuji-Mayi, les feuilles de manioc se font de plus en plus rares sur les étals des marchés. Comme souvent en période de saison sèche, ce légume, pourtant incontournable dans les habitudes alimentaires des habitants du Kasaï Oriental, devient difficile à trouver. Conséquence directe : les prix flambent, compliquant davantage le panier de la ménagère de nombreuses familles.
data.translatedTitle: Mbuji-Mayi: the scarcity of cassava leaves drives up prices on the markets
data.translatedDescription: In Mbuji-Mayi, cassava leaves are becoming increasingly rare on market stalls. As is often the case during the dry season, this vegetable, although essential in the eating habits of the inhabitants of Kasaï Oriental, becomes difficult to find. Direct consequence: prices are soaring, further complicating the household basket of many families.

data.title: RDC : des arnaqueurs proposent des offres internet à bas prix pour vider les comptes Mobile Money
data.description: La prudence est plus que jamais de mise sur internet. Depuis plusieurs jours, de nombreux consommateurs congolais signalent des cas d’arnaques en ligne ayant conduit au vol de leurs données personnelles et à la disparition de l’argent stocké sur leurs comptes Mobile Money. En cause : de fausses offres de connexion internet diffusées massivement sur les réseaux sociaux, notamment WhatsApp et Facebook. Des abonnements Starlink proposés à des prix irréalistes
data.translatedTitle: DRC: scammers offer low-cost internet offers to empty Mobile Money accounts
data.translatedDescription: Caution is more important than ever on the internet. For several days, many Congolese consumers have been reporting cases of online scams leading to the theft of their personal data and the disappearance of money stored in their Mobile Money accounts. The cause: false internet connection offers distributed massively on social networks, notably WhatsApp and Facebook. Starlink subscriptions offered at unrealistic prices

data.title: MSF alerte sur l'aggravation de la crise humanitaire en RDC
data.description: Dans son rapport annuel 2025, Médecins sans frontières (MSF) dresse le portrait d'une RDC confrontée à une accumulation de crises sécuritaires, des urgences sanitaires, de financement en baisse. Dans l’Est du pays, par exemple, les violences continuent de faire des victimes. Sur le front sanitaire, plusieurs épidémies persistent, dont Ebola qui poursuit sa progression.
data.translatedTitle: MSF warns of the worsening humanitarian crisis in the DRC
data.translatedDescription: In its 2025 annual report, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) paints a portrait of a DRC facing an accumulation of security crises, health emergencies and declining funding. In the east of the country, for example, violence continues to claim victims. On the health front, several epidemics persist, including Ebola which continues to progress.

data.title: El Moncada
data.description: Los muchachos sabían que había llegado la “hora cero”; tanto movimiento parecía ser en serio esta vez y no una práctica de tiro ni un examen de disposición de combate. Cada uno se despidió a su manera de la familia. Uno dijo que iba a una comelata en el campo, otros que irían las regatas de Varadero; otros se despidieron como si fueran al trabajo de siempre. Algunas madres no tenían idea de en qué andaban sus hijos; otras sí, aunque sin certezas porque ellos no decían una palabra... The post El Moncada first appeared on Cubadebate .
data.translatedTitle: The Moncada
data.translatedDescription: The boys knew that “zero hour” had arrived; so much movement seemed to be serious this time and not a target practice or a combat readiness test. Each one said goodbye to the family in their own way. One said he was going to a regatta in the countryside, others that they would go to the regattas in Varadero; others said goodbye as if they were going to work as usual. Some mothers had no idea what their children were up to; others do, although without certainty because they did not say a word... The post El Moncada first appeared on Cubadebate.

data.title: Mario Segura afirma que salario de diputado de 110 mil lempiras “no le ajusta”
data.description: El diputado del Partido Liberal, Mario Segura , aseguró que el salario mensual de los congresistas hondureños se reduce considerablemente debido a los gastos que deben cubrir durante su permanencia en Tegucigalpa. Segura hizo sus declaraciones al referirse a las condiciones económicas de los diputados, quienes reciben un ingreso de 110 mil lempiras , según afirmó, pero deben asumir costos de vivienda, alimentación y otros gastos personales. “Lo que nos sale de salario son 110 mil pesos, yo creo que ese tema deberíamos de aclararlo. 110 mil lempiras ”, expresó el parlamentario liberal al hablar sobre la situación económica de los legisladores. El diputado señaló que alquilar un apartamento en la capital puede representar un gasto aproximado de 15 mil lempiras , además de los costos diarios de alimentación y otros compromisos. Segura manifestó que, después de cubrir esos gastos, a un congresista podrían quedarle alrededor de 40 mil lempiras disponibles de su salario mensual. “Es duro, solo nos queda como 40 mil lempiras”, manifestó. “¿Cuánto le queda un diputado del salario y después todos los gastos de pagar el cuarto? Le pueden quedar unos 40 mil lempiras”, afirmó durante sus declaraciones. El parlamentario también indicó que los diputados enfrentan gastos adicionales al atender las demandas de ciudadanos de sus departamentos, como en su caso con los habitantes de El Paraíso. Las declaraciones de Segura surgen en medio del debate público sobre los salarios y beneficios que reciben los funcionarios del Congreso Nacional, un tema que genera cuestionamientos entre distintos sectores de la sociedad.
data.translatedTitle: Mario Segura affirms that a deputy's salary of 110 thousand lempiras "does not suit him"
data.translatedDescription: The Liberal Party deputy, Mario Segura, assured that the monthly salary of Honduran congressmen is considerably reduced due to the expenses they must cover during their stay in Tegucigalpa. Segura made his statements when referring to the economic conditions of the deputies, who receive an income of 110 thousand lempiras, as he stated, but must bear the costs of housing, food and other personal expenses. "What we get out of our salary is 110 thousand pesos, I think we should clarify this issue. 110 thousand lempiras," said the liberal parliamentarian when talking about the economic situation of the legislators. The deputy pointed out that renting an apartment in the capital can represent an approximate expense of 15 thousand lempiras, in addition to the daily costs of food and other commitments. Segura stated that, after covering these expenses, a congressman could have around 40 thousand lempiras available from his monthly salary. “It's hard, we only have about 40 thousand lempiras left,” he said. "How much does a deputy have left from his salary and then all the expenses of paying the room? He could have about 40 thousand lempiras left," he stated during his statements. The parliamentarian also indicated that the deputies face additional expenses when meeting the demands of citizens of their departments, as in their case with the inhabitants of El Paraíso. Segura's statements arise in the midst of the public debate about the salaries and benefits received by officials of the National Congress, an issue that generates questions among different sectors of society.

data.title: Fallece el alcalde de Manto, José Luis Chirinos, tras sufrir un paro cardiorrespiratorio
data.description: José Luis Chirinos, alcalde del municipio de Manto, Olancho, falleció este sábado luego de sufrir un paro cardiorrespiratorio , mientras era trasladado de emergencia hacia un centro asistencial en Tegucigalpa. De acuerdo con la información preliminar proporcionada por personas cercanas a la familia, el edil comenzó a presentar complicaciones de salud , por lo que fue estabilizado inicialmente y posteriormente movilizado en una ambulancia con destino a un hospital privado de la capital. Sin embargo, durante el trayecto su condición se deterioró. El funcionario murió antes de llegar al centro médico, a la altura del sector de Telica, según las versiones conocidas hasta el momento. La noticia generó reacciones de pesar entre habitantes de Manto, familiares y autoridades del departamento de Olancho, donde el alcalde era reconocido por su gestión al frente de la municipalidad. José Luis Chirinos se desempeñaba como jefe edil del municipio y era una de las figuras políticas más conocidas de esa zona del departamento. Hasta el momento, la alcaldía de Manto no ha emitido un comunicado oficial sobre el deceso del funcionario. Se espera que en las próximas horas la corporación municipal y los familiares informen sobre las honras fúnebres y las actividades que se realizarán para despedir al alcalde. Mientras tanto, la muerte de Chirinos enluta al municipio de Manto, cuyos habitantes lamentan la pérdida de quien dirigía la administración local.
data.translatedTitle: The mayor of Manto, José Luis Chirinos, dies after suffering cardiorespiratory arrest
data.translatedDescription: José Luis Chirinos, mayor of the municipality of Manto, Olancho, died this Saturday after suffering cardiorespiratory arrest, while being rushed to a care center in Tegucigalpa. According to preliminary information provided by people close to the family, the mayor began to present health complications, for which he was initially stabilized and later transported in an ambulance to a private hospital in the capital. However, during the journey his condition deteriorated. The official died before reaching the medical center, near the Telica sector, according to the versions known so far. The news generated reactions of regret among residents of Manto, relatives and authorities of the department of Olancho, where the mayor was recognized for his management at the head of the municipality. José Luis Chirinos served as mayor of the municipality and was one of the best-known political figures in that area of ​​the department. So far, the Manto mayor's office has not issued an official statement about the official's death. It is expected that in the next few hours the municipal corporation and the relatives will report on the funeral services and the activities that will be carried out to say goodbye to the mayor. Meanwhile, the death of Chirinos leaves the municipality of Manto in mourning, whose inhabitants mourn the loss of the person who headed the local administration.
