data.title: Asfura recorre el litoral Atlántico y anuncia proyectos de infraestructura, carreteras y vivienda
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Una gira por el litoral Atlántico realizó el presidente Nasry Asfura el pasado viernes 24 de julio, donde coordinó y supervisó varios proyectos en Puerto Castilla, Colón y varios municipios de Atlántida. En La Ceiba, Atlántida, el presidente Asfura enfocó su agenda de trabajo en conocer la realidad de la zona para avanzar y priorizar proyectos que permitan mejorar temas de infraestructura, conectividad y condiciones favorables para atraer inversión y, con ello la generación de empleo. En este importante municipio, el presidente Asfura busca recuperar la red vial, impulsar la modernización aeroportuaria, fortalecer el muelle de cabotaje, mejorar la seguridad e implementar nuevos proyectos de vivienda y salud. Según se dio a conocer desde el gobierno, ya se comenzará a trabajar en proyectos de emergencia para atender sectores como Rigores, Sinaí y otras zonas que requieren una respuesta inmediata, mientras se avanza en la planificación de la pavimentación de la carretera CA-13. Además, el presidente Asfura informó que el Banco Mundial ha destinado 100 millones de dólares y el gobierno de España 80 millones de dólares para el proyecto carretero, aunque actualmente se encuentra en etapa de estudios. Mientras avanza el proceso de licitación, las autoridades se centrarán en mejorar las condiciones de las carreteras existentes y ejecutar obras que permitan fortalecer la conectividad. Asfura también abordó el proyecto que busca la ampliación de la carretera entre La Barca, El Progreso y Tela. Según explicó, la próxima semana se abrirán las ofertas económicas para el tramo de La Barca a El Progreso. En el tema aeroportuario, Asfura anunció que se trabaja en los diseños para la remodelación del aeropuerto Guillermo Anderson de La Ceiba y que, junto con el alcalde, se trabaja en la recuperación del muelle de cabotaje. Para la recuperación del muelle se estima una inversión de 1.3 millones de dólares, los cuales serán destinados a retirar entre 10 y 12 embarcaciones hundidas, abandonadas o atracadas que actualmente ocupan espacio en la zona portuaria. Durante el recorrido por el litoral Atlántico, Asfura estuvo en la Base Naval de Puerto Castilla, donde se prevé la incorporación de nuevas cámaras hiperbáricas y anunció el fortalecimiento de la Fuerza Naval para proteger la soberanía nacional. En su visita por Trujillo, Colón, se centró en supervisar las instalaciones militares para conocer las principales necesidades operativas de la unidad. El mandatario explicó que la visita forma parte del recorrido de supervisión que realiza desde La Ceiba hasta Trujillo para evaluar proyectos estratégicos de infraestructura y desarrollo en la región. “Hoy, en comparación con la nueva tecnología, nuestros buzos, nuestra capacitación al nivel de las Fuerzas Armadas, también nuestros pescadores y cualquier otra atención que una persona necesite de las cámaras hiperbáricas, estoy seguro de que esto le va a funcionar a la población”, apuntó Asfura. Desde el Gobierno buscan el fortalecimiento de la Fuerza Naval mediante la incorporación de nuevos navíos que permitan incrementar la vigilancia y protección de las aguas territoriales hondureñas. “Estoy seguro de que esto va a estar para funcionar también para poder servirle a la población nacional. Sin duda, esta visita a las instalaciones físicas permitirá conocer las necesidades que se tienen y potenciar en su momento la importante labor que ejerce esta estación naval”, explicó el mandatario hondureño.
data.translatedTitle: Asfura tours the Atlantic coast and announces infrastructure, roads and housing projects
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- President Nasry Asfura made a tour of the Atlantic coast last Friday, July 24, where he coordinated and supervised several projects in Puerto Castilla, Colón and several municipalities of Atlántida. In La Ceiba, Atlántida, President Asfura focused his work agenda on knowing the reality of the area to advance and prioritize projects that improve infrastructure, connectivity and favorable conditions to attract investment and, with it, the generation of employment. In this important municipality, President Asfura seeks to recover the road network, promote airport modernization, strengthen the cabotage dock, improve security and implement new housing and health projects. As announced by the government, work will begin on emergency projects to serve sectors such as Rigores, Sinaí and other areas that require an immediate response, while progress is made in planning the paving of the CA-13 highway. In addition, President Asfura reported that the World Bank has allocated 100 million dollars and the government of Spain 80 million dollars for the highway project, although it is currently in the study stage. While the bidding process progresses, authorities will focus on improving the conditions of existing roads and executing works that strengthen connectivity. Asfura also addressed the project that seeks to expand the highway between La Barca, El Progreso and Tela. As explained, next week the economic offers will be opened for the section from La Barca to El Progreso. On the airport issue, Asfura announced that they are working on the designs for the remodeling of the Guillermo Anderson airport in La Ceiba and that, together with the mayor, they are working on the recovery of the cabotage dock. To recover the dock, an investment of 1.3 million dollars is estimated, which will be used to remove between 10 and 12 sunken, abandoned or docked vessels that currently occupy space in the port area. During the tour along the Atlantic coast, Asfura was at the Puerto Castilla Naval Base, where the incorporation of new hyperbaric chambers is planned and announced the strengthening of the Naval Force to protect national sovereignty. During his visit to Trujillo, Colón focused on supervising military installations to learn about the main operational needs of the unit. The president explained that the visit is part of the supervision tour he carries out from La Ceiba to Trujillo to evaluate strategic infrastructure and development projects in the region. “Today, compared to the new technology, our divers, our training at the level of the Armed Forces, also our fishermen and any other attention that a person needs from hyperbaric chambers, I am sure that this will work for the population,” Asfura noted. The Government seeks to strengthen the Naval Force through the incorporation of new vessels that will increase the surveillance and protection of Honduran territorial waters. "I am sure that this will also work to be able to serve the national population. Without a doubt, this visit to the physical facilities will allow us to know the needs that exist and enhance in due course the important work carried out by this naval station," explained the Honduran president.

data.title: Buscan a niña de 11 años desaparecida en la colonia Nuevos Horizontes de San Pedro Sula
data.description: San Pedro Sula, Cortés.- La angustia se apoderó de una familia sampedrana cuando Génesis María Ortiz Ramírez , de 11 años , desapareció a tempranas horas de la mañana en la colonia Nuevos Horizontes , sector Perfecto Vázquez, también conocido como Satélite, en San Pedro Sula, departamento de Cortés, en la zona norte de Honduras . Según el relato brindado por la madre al noticieros Hoy Mismo, la desaparición ocurrió alrededor de las 5:30 a. m. del miércoles 22 de julio , cuando Génesis salió al patio de la vivienda para bañarse antes de prepararse e ir a la escuela. Minutos después y al notar la tardanza, su padre salió a buscarla, pero descubrió que ya no se encontraba en el lugar, luego de que la menor se subiera a un vehículo, según comentó una vecina de la zona. Tras interponer la denuncia ante la Dirección Policial de Investigaciones (DPI) , un grupo de pobladores del sector Perfecto Vásquez y la colonia Nuevos Horizontes se organizaron para iniciar la búsqueda de Génesis en distintos puntos de San Pedro Sula; sin embargo, hasta el momento no han logrado encontrar pistas sobre su paradero. La madre de Génesis explicó al canal HCH que acudió al centro educativo para conocer si la menor había tenido algún problema o discusión dentro de la institución, recibiendo una respuesta negativa de las autoridades del recinto escolar. Además, pidió a cualquier persona que sepa algo sobre el paradero de su hija, ponerse una mano en el corazón y no detener la búsqueda hasta encontrarla. Los seres queridos de Génesis aseguran vivir momentos de desesperación y hacen un llamado a cualquier persona que pueda aportar información sobre su ubicación. Quienes tengan datos que ayuden a localizar a la menor pueden comunicarse al +504 8987-9151 o informar de inmediato a las autoridades competentes.
data.translatedTitle: They search for an 11-year-old girl missing in the Nuevos Horizontes neighborhood of San Pedro Sula
data.translatedDescription: San Pedro Sula, Cortés.- Anguish took over a San Pedro Sula family when Génesis María Ortiz Ramírez, 11 years old, disappeared early in the morning in the Nuevos Horizontes neighborhood, Perfecto Vázquez sector, also known as Satélite, in San Pedro Sula, department of Cortés, in the northern part of Honduras. According to the story given by the mother to Hoy Mismo news, the disappearance occurred around 5:30 a.m. m. on Wednesday, July 22, when Génesis went out to the patio of the house to take a bath before getting ready and going to school. Minutes later and upon noticing the delay, her father went out to look for her, but discovered that she was no longer there, after the minor got into a vehicle, according to a neighbor in the area. After filing a complaint with the Police Investigation Directorate (DPI), a group of residents from the Perfecto Vásquez sector and the Nuevos Horizontes neighborhood organized to begin the search for Génesis in different parts of San Pedro Sula; However, so far they have not been able to find clues about his whereabouts. Génesis' mother explained to the HCH channel that she went to the educational center to find out if the minor had had any problem or discussion within the institution, receiving a negative response from the school authorities. In addition, he asked anyone who knows anything about his daughter's whereabouts to put a hand on their heart and not stop the search until they find her. Génesis' loved ones say they are living in moments of desperation and are appealing to anyone who can provide information about their location. Those who have information that helps locate the minor can contact +504 8987-9151 or immediately inform the competent authorities.

data.title: Capturan a "El Indio" supuesto integrante de la Mara Salvatrucha en Langue, Valle
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -En posesión de un fusil de uso prohibido , una pistola 9 milímetros, fue capturado un hombre de 45 años de edad a quien se le supone ser integrante de la Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) en Langue, Valle. La detención la ejecutaron agentes de la Dirección Nacional Policial Antidrogas (DNPA) mediante labores de vigilancia y seguimiento, ya que se le supone responsable del delito de portación ilegal de arma de fuego de uso prohibido y uso permitido en perjuicio del orden público. Las autoridades policiales informaron que el capturado es originario de la aldea Los Horcones del municipio de Langue, Valle. El equipo especializado antidrogas mientras realizaban trabajos de vigilancia y seguimiento lograron identificar al sospechoso, por lo que procedieron a la detención. Al momento de la captura se le encontró en posesión de un arma de fuego tipo pistola con diez proyectiles 9 milímetros, un arma de fuego tipo fusil con 28 proyectiles calibre 7.72 sin percutir. Se informó que el detenido contaba con una orden de captura pendiente por suponerlo responsable del delito de asesinato. Las autoridades policiales remitieron al detenido a la Fiscalía del Ministerio Público para continuar con el proceso judicial que establece la ley y que responda por los delitos que se le imputan. Los equipos de la DNPA continúan con las operaciones para combatir y desarticular estructuras criminales que vulneran la seguridad en Honduras y especialmente en la zona sur del país.
data.translatedTitle: They capture "El Indio" an alleged member of the Mara Salvatrucha in Langue, Valle
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras. -In possession of a prohibited rifle, a 9 millimeter pistol, a 45-year-old man who is believed to be a member of the Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) was captured in Langue, Valle. The arrest was carried out by agents of the National Anti-Drug Police Directorate (DNPA) through surveillance and monitoring tasks, since they are presumed responsible for the crime of illegal carrying of a firearm of prohibited use and permitted use to the detriment of public order. The police authorities reported that the captured person is originally from the village of Los Horcones in the municipality of Langue, Valle. The specialized anti-drug team, while carrying out surveillance and monitoring work, managed to identify the suspect, so they proceeded to arrest him. At the time of capture, he was found in possession of a pistol-type firearm with ten 9-millimeter projectiles, a rifle-type firearm with 28 unexploded 7.72 caliber projectiles. It was reported that the detainee had a pending arrest warrant for assuming he was responsible for the crime of murder. The police authorities referred the detainee to the Public Prosecutor's Office to continue with the judicial process established by law and to answer for the crimes he is accused of. DNPA teams continue operations to combat and dismantle criminal structures that violate security in Honduras and especially in the southern part of the country.

data.title: Le pidió amarrar los perros y el dueño lo mató: muere exregidor en Goascorán y su hijo queda herido
data.description: Valle, Honduras. - Un hombre muerto y un menor de edad herido, hijo de la víctima, dejó un pleito registrado en el municipio de Goascorán, Valle. La persona fallecida fue identificada como Rafael Herrera, quien se desempeñó como exregidor de ese municipio y además era un reconocido comerciante de la zona. El hijo de la víctima, quien lleva el mismo nombre, resultó con heridas de gravedad y fue trasladado a un centro asistencial, donde permanece bajo atención médica. Según versiones preliminares, el conflicto se originó luego de que Herrera llegara a una vivienda para reclamar por unos perros que presuntamente tenían un comportamiento agresivo, y solicitara al dueño que los mantuviera amarrados. La petición de la víctima habría molestado al propietario de los animales, quien supuestamente sacó un arma de fuego y les disparó en varias ocasiones, causando la muerte de Herrera y dejando herido al menor. De manera preliminar, el presunto responsable sería un exguardia de seguridad que laboró en una cooperativa de la zona fronteriza de El Amatillo. Sin embargo, esta información aún no ha sido confirmada oficialmente por las autoridades.
data.translatedTitle: He asked him to tie the dogs and the owner killed him: former councilor in Goascorán dies and his son is injured
data.translatedDescription: Valley, Honduras. - A dead man and an injured minor, the victim's son, left a lawsuit registered in the municipality of Goascorán, Valle. The deceased person was identified as Rafael Herrera, who served as former councilor of that municipality and was also a well-known merchant in the area. The victim's son, who bears the same name, was seriously injured and was taken to a care center, where he remains under medical care. According to preliminary versions, the conflict arose after Herrera arrived at a home to complain about some dogs that allegedly had aggressive behavior, and asked the owner to keep them tied up. The victim's request would have bothered the owner of the animals, who allegedly pulled out a firearm and shot them several times, causing Herrera's death and leaving the minor injured. Preliminarily, the alleged perpetrator would be a former security guard who worked in a cooperative in the border area of ​​El Amatillo. However, this information has not yet been officially confirmed by the authorities.

data.title: Embolsado hallan el cuerpo de una persona en la entrada de la colonia Nueva Suyapa
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El cuerpo de una persona, aún sin identificar, fue encontrado dentro de una b olsa negra en la entrada de la colonia Nueva Suyapa, en Tegucigalpa. El hallazgo ocurrió en una de las zonas más transitadas del sector, donde funciona un punto de mototaxis y existen varias casetas donde se comercializan diferentes tipos de productos. Fueron comerciantes de la zona quienes alertaron a las autoridades luego de encontrar la escena en la vía pública. Según los reportes preliminares, el cuerpo fue dejado sobre la acera, pese a que en el lugar hay abundante maleza. El hallazgo se registró en la entrada de la colonia Nueva Suyapa, a pocos metros de la rotonda ubicada cerca de la Basílica de Suyapa. Hasta el momento, las autoridades no han revelado detalles sobre su identidad ni las posibles circunstancias en las que ocurrió el hecho. Equipos policiales llegaron al lugar para acordonar la zona y realizar las primeras investigaciones, mientras personal de Medicina Forense llevó a cabo el levantamiento cadavérico. Tras finalizar el procedimiento, personal forense trasladó el cuerpo hasta la morgue del Ministerio Público, donde se realizarán los análisis correspondientes para determinar su identidad y obtener información que permita esclarecer el caso. Las autoridades continuarán con las investigaciones para establecer quién era la persona encontrada y determinar las causas de su muerte.
data.translatedTitle: The body of a person is found bagged at the entrance to the Nueva Suyapa neighborhood
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- The body of a person, still unidentified, was found inside a black bag at the entrance of the Nueva Suyapa neighborhood, in Tegucigalpa. The discovery occurred in one of the busiest areas of the sector, where a motorcycle taxi point operates and there are several booths where different types of products are sold. It was merchants from the area who alerted the authorities after finding the scene on the public road. According to preliminary reports, the body was left on the sidewalk, despite the fact that there is abundant weeds there. The discovery was recorded at the entrance to the Nueva Suyapa neighborhood, a few meters from the roundabout located near the Basilica of Suyapa. So far, authorities have not revealed details about his identity or the possible circumstances under which the incident occurred. Police teams arrived at the scene to cordon off the area and carry out the first investigations, while Forensic Medicine personnel carried out the cadaveric removal. After completing the procedure, forensic personnel transported the body to the morgue of the Public Ministry, where the corresponding analyzes will be carried out to determine its identity and obtain information that will clarify the case. The authorities will continue with the investigations to establish who the person found was and determine the causes of his death.

data.title: Las claves para entender el regreso de Juan Orlando Hernández a Honduras
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El expresidente hondureño Juan Orlando Hernández, indultado por Estados Unidos de una condena a 45 años de cárcel por narcotráfico y comercio ilegal de armas, regresará este domingo a Honduras de manera voluntaria para responder a los cargos de fraude y lavado de dinero ante la justicia hondureña, y ponerla a prueba, como ha alertado el ente anticorrupción. Hernández, de 57 años, es un político que en su momento logró movilizar a buena parte de los hondureños, ante los que se mostró como un líder de carácter fuerte, y que generó polémica por varias medidas durante sus mandatos, incluida su cuestionada reelección en 2017. Estas son las claves para entender su regreso: Hernández gobernó Honduras durante dos períodos consecutivos (2014-2022). En abril de 2022, apenas tres meses después de traspasar el poder, se convirtió en el primer expresidente del país extraditado a Estados Unidos. En 2024, una corte federal de Nueva York lo condenó a 45 años de prisión por tres cargos relacionados con el tráfico de armas y la conspiración para ingresar cientos de toneladas de cocaína a territorio estadounidense, e incluso haber recibido dinero del capo mexicano Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán. El panorama legal de Hernández dio un vuelco radical en 2025, cuando el exjefe de Estado recuperó el 1 de diciembre de ese año su libertad, tras recibir un indulto del presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, quien afirmó que la Administración del expresidente Joe Biden (2021-2025) le había "tendido una trampa" al hondureño. Trump anunció el perdón presidencial el 28 de noviembre, en vísperas de las elecciones generales en Honduras ganadas por el conservador Nasry 'Tito' Asfura, del Partido Nacional, con quien Hernández tiene afinidad. Tras la medida ejecutiva, el juez federal Kevin Castel formalizó la anulación de la sentencia y el cierre definitivo del expediente. El regreso de Hernández se concretará después de que un juez hondureño suspendiera de forma provisional la orden de captura internacional y la alerta roja de Interpol que pesaban en su contra. La determinación judicial atendió una solicitud formulada por la defensa del exmandatario para someterse a la justicia de manera voluntaria, lo que le garantiza ingresar al país sin ser detenido inmediatamente a su arribo. El exgobernante deberá enfrentar en Honduras un proceso por presunto fraude y lavado de activos relacionado con el supuesto desvío de fondos públicos utilizados para financiar su campaña electoral en 2013, dentro de una trama en la que también figuran el expresidente Porfirio Lobo (2010-2014), exdiputados y empresarios. Un juez competente fijó para el próximo 3 de agosto la audiencia inicial de declaración de imputación, en la que Hernández conocerá formalmente los cargos y su representación legal solicitará que se le permita afrontar el proceso penal bajo medidas sustitutivas a la prisión preventiva. "Todos los demás involucrados en ese proceso se presentaron voluntariamente. La mayoría de ellos ya fueron liberados de sus cargos y están en libertad, y los demás siguen un proceso común y corriente", declaró Hernández, sobre la acusación, en una entrevista con EFE, en Miami (EE.UU.). El retorno del exmandatario reaviva el debate sobre la independencia del Poder Judicial hondureño. Mientras su círculo cercano y militantes afines consideran su regreso como una oportunidad para demostrar su inocencia, diversas voces de la oposición y de organizaciones anticorrupción expresan su temor ante eventuales privilegios procesales. La directora del Consejo Nacional Anticorrupción (CNA), Gabriela Castellanos, cree que el desafío no es el retorno de Hernández, sino demostrar que la justicia actúa sin privilegios. "El problema nunca ha sido su regreso. El problema siempre ha sido la facilidad con la que el poder encuentra protegerlo", afirmó la funcionaria, al señalar que su caso será una prueba para las instituciones hondureñas. En la misma línea, la excandidata presidencial del izquierdista Libertad y Refundación (Libre) Rixi Moncada ha exigido que las instituciones apliquen la ley con objetividad y sin concesiones.
data.translatedTitle: The keys to understanding the return of Juan Orlando Hernández to Honduras
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Former Honduran president Juan Orlando Hernández, pardoned by the United States from a 45-year prison sentence for drug trafficking and illegal arms trade, will return this Sunday to Honduras voluntarily to respond to charges of fraud and money laundering before the Honduran justice system, and put it to the test, as the anti-corruption entity has warned. Hernández, 57 years old, is a politician who at the time managed to mobilize a good part of Hondurans, to whom he showed himself to be a leader of strong character, and who generated controversy for several measures during his mandates, including his questioned re-election in 2017. These are the keys to understanding his return: Hernández governed Honduras for two consecutive periods (2014-2022). In April 2022, just three months after transferring power, he became the country's first former president extradited to the United States. In 2024, a federal court in New York sentenced him to 45 years in prison for three charges related to arms trafficking and conspiracy to bring hundreds of tons of cocaine into the United States, and even receiving money from Mexican kingpin Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán. Hernández's legal outlook took a radical turn in 2025, when the former head of state regained his freedom on December 1 of that year, after receiving a pardon from US President Donald Trump, who stated that the Administration of former President Joe Biden (2021-2025) had "set a trap" for the Honduran. Trump announced the presidential pardon on November 28, on the eve of the general elections in Honduras won by conservative Nasry 'Tito' Asfura, of the National Party, with whom Hernández has an affinity. After the executive measure, federal judge Kevin Castel formalized the annulment of the sentence and the definitive closure of the file. Hernández's return will take place after a Honduran judge provisionally suspended the international arrest warrant and the Interpol red alert against him. The judicial determination responded to a request made by the former president's defense to submit to justice voluntarily, which guarantees him entering the country without being detained immediately upon arrival. The former ruler must face a process in Honduras for alleged fraud and money laundering related to the alleged diversion of public funds used to finance his electoral campaign in 2013, within a plot that also includes former president Porfirio Lobo (2010-2014), former deputies and businessmen. A competent judge set the initial hearing for the declaration of charges for next August 3, in which Hernández will formally hear the charges and his legal representation will request that he be allowed to face the criminal process under alternative measures to preventive detention. "All the others involved in that process presented themselves voluntarily. Most of them have already been released from their charges and are free, and the others are following a common and ordinary process," said Hernández, regarding the accusation, in an interview with EFE, in Miami (USA). The return of the former president revives the debate on the independence of the Honduran Judiciary. While his close circle and related militants consider his return as an opportunity to prove his innocence, various voices from the opposition and anti-corruption organizations express their fear of possible procedural privileges. The director of the National Anti-Corruption Council (CNA), Gabriela Castellanos, believes that the challenge is not the return of Hernández, but rather demonstrating that justice acts without privileges. "The problem has never been his return. The problem has always been the ease with which power finds it to protect him," said the official, noting that her case will be a test for Honduran institutions. Along the same lines, the former presidential candidate of the leftist Libertad y Refoundación (Libre) Rixi Moncada has demanded that institutions apply the law objectively and without concessions.

data.title: Consultor de empresa supervisora minimiza fallas en puente Papa Francisco
data.description: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- El ingeniero Joaquín Torre, consultor externo de la Asociación de Consultores en Ingeniería (ACI) — la firma encargada del diseño y la supervisión del puente Papa Francisco —, defendió categóricamente la estabilidad de la obra y rechazó fallas estructurales en el diseño de la obra a desnivel que está bajo auditoría por parte de la alcaldía capitalina por sus grietas. En una entrevista exclusiva con EL HERALDO Plus, el especialista minimizó las alertas emitidas por la empresa constructora, Ingenieros Calona de Honduras (Incah) , y las auditorías independientes. "Ellos no son ingenieros estructurales, ellos son contratistas", afirmó Torre, puntualizando que las fisuras detectadas obedecen a un comportamiento físico previsible de los materiales y no a fallas en la estructura. Además, dejó en claro que "el puente se sometió a una revisión de parte de la alcaldía. Pero el puente no está en ningún riesgo de que vaya a colapsar o nada de eso. He escuchado en la calle opiniones sin ningún fundamento". Sin embargo, el informe al que tuvo acceso de forma exclusiva la Unidad de Investigación de EL HERALDO Plus no señala que la obra corra riesgo de colapso, aunque sí asegura que la estructura está comprometida. Para el diseñador de la obra, las fisuras de entre 1.5 y 2 milímetros registradas en la estructura antes, durante y después de su habilitación parcial el 21 de noviembre de 2025, son contracciones térmicas normales del concreto provocadas de forma inevitable por los cambios de temperatura ambiental. Torre insistió que estas anomalías superficiales fueron magnificadas ante la opinión pública y los medios de comunicación. Sostuvo que las inspecciones con rayos X demostraron que las fisuras ni siquiera traspasaron el recubrimiento del hormigón, es decir, el espacio que protege las varillas de hierro internas, por lo que nunca han comprometido la seguridad del proyecto. A pesar de la controversia técnica, la obra destaca por su complejidad y magnitud en la capital hondureña. Torre explicó que el puente experimenta una transición geométrica en su recorrido, pasando de ser un bloque de concreto sólido a uno hueco con unos cinco metros de las bases de apoyo. "Ahí donde termina la parte sólida y empieza la parte hueca, hay un cambio drástico de rigidez. Y ese cambio drástico de rigidez dio lugar a que cuando hubiesen contracciones, naturalmente aparecieran esas fisuras", señaló el consultor. Según su análisis, el concreto se expande con el calor y se contrae con el frío de forma desigual debido a este cambio de masa, provocando tensiones visibles que varían según la hora del día. Respecto al déficit de acero que señalan las auditorías independientes, el diseñador aclaró que el problema no radica en la cantidad total del material, sino en la distribución de las varillas en los planos técnicos. "No es porque vaya a usar más acero, sino que es la distribución. A veces es mejor usar barras de menor calibre, pero más pequeñas y distribuidas, que son el equivalente a barras de mayor calibre, pero su mejor distribución permite un mejor control de la fisuración", admitió Torre, reconociendo que debió haber indicado un calibre menor con una distribución más eficiente en los diseños originales, aunque reiteró que esto no compromete la seguridad. Asimismo, atribuyó un asentamiento inicial de 19 milímetros a una falla de procedimiento de la constructora Incah, que empleó rampas de tierra compactada en lugar de andamios tradicionales de metal y retiró el soporte de un solo lado de manera prematura. Llegar a la versión técnica de Torre requirió un prolongado rastreo periodístico por parte de la Unidad de Investigación de EL HERALDO Plus. Este rotativo contactó en primera instancia al ingeniero Roberto Andino, gerente de la firma supervisora ACI , quien delegó formalmente la vocería técnica en él: "El ingeniero estructural Joaquín Torre es nuestro ingeniero diseñador, él se pronunciará al respecto". Las declaraciones de la firma diseñadora contrastan firmemente con la documentación oficial del proyecto que está en poder de este rotativo. El informe de campo INCAH-G-01-26, enviado el 16 de enero de 2026 al gerente de proyecto de ACI, hace constar que los especialistas identificaron las grietas en la pilastra 1 antes de la habilitación de la vía. El documento revela fallas en el flujo de información interna, ya que el personal de supervisión de ACI catalogó los daños verbalmente como "fisuras menores causadas por el calor de hidratación" durante una inspección el 12 de noviembre de 2025, omitiendo notificar por escrito a la Alcaldía Municipal del Distrito Central (AMDC) hasta mediados de enero de 2026. El informe de 500 páginas contiene también los hallazgos de un análisis elaborado por los consultores independientes Augusto C. Destephen y Nelson Centeno, quienes concluyen que el paso a desnivel presenta un "estado estructural comprometido". El dictamen sostiene que la viga principal fue calculada erróneamente como una viga común lineal, ignorando las características geométricas de gran altura que requería el puente. Como consecuencia de este diseño, la estructura comenzó a comportarse como un arco bajo los efectos de su propio peso, generando concentración de esfuerzos y un déficit de acero de refuerzo. Para su habilitación total, las auditorías recomiendan reforzar las vigas con fibra de carbono, sustituir los apoyos de neopreno y realizar una inspección integral. En el terreno de las controversias, el ingeniero Torre denunció la existencia de corrientes de opinión que, según sus declaraciones, promueven la demolición de la estructura debido a motivaciones políticas asociadas al cambio de administración municipal, aunque de manera formal no se ha conocido una postura de esta naturaleza. Por su parte, el alcalde Juan Diego Zelaya ordenó un nuevo estudio sobre la factibilidad de poner en operación el puente Papa Francisco y decidió suspender los trabajos y no habilitarlo hasta contar con garantías de seguridad. “Pedimos otro estudio, casualmente un quinto”, admitió Zelaya, detallando que un nuevo equipo de expertos nacionales ya se encuentra en el país para reevaluar el viaducto. Por su parte, Torre insistió en una campaña de desinformación: "Incluso vi un comentario que me llegó en donde alguien decía que por el simple hecho de que el puente había sido ordenado por el gobierno anterior, este nuevo gobierno llevaba como misión demolerlo", manifestó el consultor, aclarando que no asume que esa sea la postura oficial de la actual Alcaldía, pero lamentando la incertidumbre generada en la población de manera injustificada. Además de conocer las valoraciones de Torre, la Unidad de Investigación de EL HERALDO Plus insistió en obtener una versión del gerente de ACI, quien de forma breve defendió su impacto a largo plazo: "Cuando se habilite, será lo más espectacular que tendrá Tegucigalpa en sus vías; ya que es el único puente de vigas cajón de 227 metros y bajo dicho puente tendrá una rotonda de 80 metros de diámetro; en este intercambio distribuirá el tráfico para cualquier clase de vehículos y resolverá la vialidad en la zona". El gerente de ACI se comprometió a brindar una entrevista más profunda la próxima semana a este medio. Hasta el momento, la municipalidad de Zelaya compartió que la supervisora ACI posee un contrato acumulado de 44.2 millones de lempiras (con 26.7 millones ya desembolsados), aunque los documentos en manos de EL HERALDO Plus indican que el contrato firmado por Jorge Aldana fue de 30.2 millones de lempiras. Mientras que la constructora Ingenieros Calona ya  facturó 347.3 millones de lempiras —lo que equivale al 69.63% del presupuesto— de los 498 millones que tiene del contrato autorizado en la administración anterior.
data.translatedTitle: Supervisory company consultant minimizes failures in Pope Francis bridge
data.translatedDescription: Tegucigalpa, Honduras.- Engineer Joaquín Torre, external consultant of the Association of Engineering Consultants (ACI) - the firm in charge of the design and supervision of the Papa Francisco Bridge -, categorically defended the stability of the work and rejected structural flaws in the design of the uneven work that is under audit by the capital's mayor's office due to its cracks. In an exclusive interview with EL HERALDO Plus, the specialist minimized the alerts issued by the construction company, Ingenieros Calona de Honduras (Incah), and the independent audits. "They are not structural engineers, they are contractors," said Torre, pointing out that the cracks detected are due to a predictable physical behavior of the materials and not to failures in the structure. In addition, he made it clear that "the bridge underwent a review by the mayor's office. But the bridge is not at any risk of collapsing or anything like that. I have heard opinions on the street without any basis." However, the report to which the EL HERALDO Plus Investigation Unit had exclusive access does not indicate that the work is at risk of collapse, although it does ensure that the structure is compromised. For the designer of the work, the cracks of between 1.5 and 2 millimeters registered in the structure before, during and after its partial commissioning on November 21, 2025, are normal thermal contractions of the concrete inevitably caused by changes in ambient temperature. Torre insisted that these superficial anomalies were magnified before public opinion and the media. He maintained that the X-ray inspections showed that the cracks did not even penetrate the concrete coating, that is, the space that protects the internal iron rods, so they have never compromised the safety of the project. Despite the technical controversy, the work stands out for its complexity and magnitude in the Honduran capital. Torre explained that the bridge experiences a geometric transition in its path, going from being a solid concrete block to a hollow one with about five meters of support bases. "There where the solid part ends and the hollow part begins, there is a drastic change in rigidity. And this drastic change in rigidity gave rise to the fact that when there were contractions, those cracks naturally appeared," said the consultant. According to their analysis, concrete expands with heat and contracts with cold unevenly due to this change in mass, causing visible stresses that vary depending on the time of day. Regarding the steel deficit indicated by independent audits, the designer clarified that the problem does not lie in the total amount of material, but in the distribution of the rods in the technical plans. "It is not because it is going to use more steel, but it is the distribution. Sometimes it is better to use smaller gauge bars, but smaller and more distributed, which are the equivalent of larger gauge bars, but their better distribution allows for better control of cracking," Torre admitted, acknowledging that he should have indicated a smaller gauge with a more efficient distribution in the original designs, although he reiterated that this does not compromise safety. Likewise, he attributed an initial settlement of 19 millimeters to a procedural failure by the construction company Incah, which used compacted earth ramps instead of traditional metal scaffolding and prematurely removed the support from only one side. Getting to Torre's technical version required a lengthy journalistic search by the EL HERALDO Plus Investigation Unit. This newspaper first contacted engineer Roberto Andino, manager of the supervisory firm ACI, who formally delegated the technical spokesperson to him: "The structural engineer Joaquín Torre is our design engineer, he will rule on the matter." The statements of the design firm contrast firmly with the official documentation of the project that is in the possession of this newspaper. The field report INCAH-G-01-26, sent on January 16, 2026 to the ACI project manager, states that the specialists identified the cracks in pilaster 1 before the track was opened. The document reveals flaws in the flow of internal information, as ACI supervisory staff verbally classified the damage as "minor cracks caused by heat of hydration" during an inspection on November 12, 2025, failing to notify the Central District Municipal Mayor's Office (AMDC) in writing until mid-January 2026. The 500-page report also contains the findings of an analysis prepared by independent consultants Augusto C. Destephen and Nelson Centeno, who conclude that the overpass presents a "compromised structural state." The opinion maintains that the main girder was erroneously calculated as a common linear girder, ignoring the high-rise geometric characteristics that the bridge required. As a consequence of this design, the structure began to behave like an arch under the effects of its own weight, generating stress concentration and a deficit of reinforcing steel. For full approval, the audits recommend reinforcing the beams with carbon fiber, replacing the neoprene supports and carrying out a comprehensive inspection. In the field of controversies, engineer Torre denounced the existence of currents of opinion that, according to his statements, promote the demolition of the structure due to political motivations associated with the change of municipal administration, although a position of this nature has not been formally known. For his part, Mayor Juan Diego Zelaya ordered a new study on the feasibility of putting the Papa Francisco Bridge into operation and decided to suspend the work and not enable it until there were safety guarantees. “We asked for another study, coincidentally a fifth,” Zelaya admitted, detailing that a new team of national experts is already in the country to reevaluate the viaduct. For his part, Torre insisted on a misinformation campaign: "I even saw a comment that came to me where someone said that for the simple fact that the bridge had been ordered by the previous government, this new government's mission was to demolish it," said the consultant, clarifying that he does not assume that this is the official position of the current Mayor's Office, but regretting the uncertainty generated in the population in an unjustified manner. In addition to knowing Torre's assessments, the EL HERALDO Plus Investigation Unit insisted on obtaining a version from the ACI manager, who briefly defended its long-term impact: "When it is enabled, it will be the most spectacular thing that Tegucigalpa will have on its roads; since it is the only 227-meter box girder bridge and under said bridge it will have a roundabout 80 meters in diameter; at this interchange it will distribute traffic for any type of vehicle and will resolve the road situation. in the area." The ACI manager promised to provide a more in-depth interview next week to this medium. So far, the municipality of Zelaya shared that the ACI supervisor has an accumulated contract of 44.2 million lempiras (with 26.7 million already disbursed), although the documents in the hands of EL HERALDO Plus indicate that the contract signed by Jorge Aldana was 30.2 million lempiras. While the construction company Ingenieros Calona has already invoiced 347.3 million lempiras - which is equivalent to 69.63% of the budget - of the 498 million it has from the contract authorized in the previous administration.

Me nõuamegi, et saaksime väikseid infokilde hetkega alla neelata. Ekraanide suur eelis on mõistagi see, et need hoiavad meid alati ja kõikjal toimuvaga kursis. data.translatedTitle: One simple habit can be the best thing you do for your brain
data.translatedDescription: Our modern habits of using social media, watching short videos and responding to constant notifications have changed the way we consume information. We demand to be able to swallow small pieces of information in an instant. The great advantage of screens is, of course, that they keep us always and everywhere informed. However, according to neuroscientists, nothing can replace immersing yourself in a good book.

data.title: Viikingeid on liialt ühekülgselt mõistetud – tegelikkus üllatab
data.description: Viikinginäitusele minnes ootab enamik külastajaid mõõku, laevu ja jõulisi sõdalasi. Tegelik viikingiaeg oli aga palju mitmekesisem ning sinna kuulusid ka talupidajad, kaupmehed, naised ja keerukad kultuurikontaktid. Skandinaavia muuseumid püüavad seda pilti avardada, kuid peavad samal ajal arvestama müütidega, mis publikut saalidesse toovad. Nii sünnib näitusel kummaline segu ajaloost, rahvuslikust enesekuvandist ja tänapäeva väärtustest. Mida näitab viikingite kujutamine tegelikult nende kohta, kes neid praegu esitlevad? Lundi ülikooli museoloogiateadur Julia Håkansson teeb sellest ülevaate.
data.translatedTitle: The Vikings have been understood too one-sidedly - the reality is surprising
data.translatedDescription: When going to a Viking exhibition, most visitors expect swords, ships and powerful warriors. However, the actual Viking Age was much more diverse and included farmers, merchants, women and complex cultural contacts. Scandinavian museums try to expand this image, but at the same time have to take into account the myths that bring the audience to the halls. This is how the exhibition creates a strange mixture of history, national self-image and contemporary values. What does the depiction of the Vikings actually reveal about those who present them today? Lund University museology researcher Julia Håkansson reviews it.

Teadlased võtsid eeskuju elevandi kortsulisest nahast ja tegid tsemendiplaadi, mis imeb vee endasse ning laseb sellel aegamisi aurustuda. Tulemuseks on pind, mis püsib märksa jahedam ilma müriseva kliimaseadmeta. Mida rohkem materjal oskuslikult «higistab», seda vähem peab hoone elektrit kulutama. data.translatedTitle: How to cool a hot house - put an "elephant skin" on it
data.translatedDescription: Usually a crack in the wall means trouble, but this time just the crack can save the house from the heat. The researchers took the example of the wrinkled skin of an elephant and made a cement board that absorbs water and allows it to gradually evaporate. The result is a surface that stays much cooler without a roaring air conditioner. The more skillfully the material "sweats", the less electricity the building has to consume. Will the houses of the future cool themselves like elephants?

data.title: US Considers Ground Assault to Extract Enriched Uranium from Iran
data.description: The Pentagon is developing scenarios for a large-scale ground operation in Iran aimed at seizing or destroying the country’s stockpiles of enriched uranium. The potential ground raid is being considered as an alternative to ongoing airstrikes against Iranian nuclear infrastructure. The operation would reportedly require thousands of US troops to secure perimeters, clear mines, and breach fortified underground complexes at sites such as Fordow, Isfahan, and “Pickaxe Mountain” near Natanz, before specialized units like Navy SEALs and Army Rangers extract or neutralize the nuclear material. The International Atomic Energy Agency estimated in 2025 that Iran had accumulated over nine tons of enriched uranium. Security analysts warn such a mission would carry severe risks and potential casualties, given the heavy fortification and mining of the facilities.

data.title: Russia Preparing to Receive 30,000 Additional North Korean Troops, Zelensky Warns

data.title: Russia Strikes Kyiv, Kryvyi Rih Shopping Center, Civilian Cargo Ship
data.description: Russian forces launched a widespread drone and ballistic missile attack against Ukraine early Sunday morning, July 26, striking multiple urban centers and civilian maritime infrastructure. In Kyiv, debris and strikes caused fires across the Desnianskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, and Solomianskyi districts. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko noted that debris hit an 18-story residential building, igniting a fire on the 7th and 8th floors. No casualties were reported in the capital. Concurrently, Russian forces attacked the central city of Kryvyi Rih, striking a shopping center and causing a large fire. In the Black Sea, on July 25, Russian drones twice struck a civilian cargo ship sailing under the flag of Palau as it departed a port in the Odesa region carrying 2,800 tons of corn.

data.title: Russia Cuts Funding for Putin’s Flagship Technology Projects
data.description: Russia has cut funding for eight of its key “technological leadership” projects for 2025. Total allocations were reduced by 37.8% to 201.9 billion rubles ($2.6 billion). The most significant cuts impacted the space technology project, which received zero funding, and the Means of Production and Automation project, which saw its budget slashed by more than fourfold. Other affected sectors include new materials, health preservation, and food security. The only initiative to receive its full planned funding was the government’s drone development program, which saw a slight increase to 35.7 billion rubles ($460.5 million).

data.title: EU Allows Member States to Sell Confiscated Russian Oil in 21st Sanctions Package
data.description: The EU adopted its 21st sanctions package against Russia on July 23, introducing measures targeting the country’s energy revenues, financial infrastructure, and sanctions evasion tactics. A key provision allows EU member states to legally confiscate and sell crude oil and other commodities seized from Russia’s “shadow fleet” vessels intercepted during naval operations. The package also freezes the Russian oil price cap at $44 per barrel for 12 months, preventing an automatic increase to $58. Additionally, the EU expanded sanctions to 218 new designations and introduced a mechanism enabling third-country bans on crypto-asset services that facilitate sanctions circumvention.

data.title: Trump Administration Warns Ukraine Against Attacking Non-Russian Vessels
data.description: The Trump administration has formally warned Ukraine to refrain from attacking non-Russian vessels in the Black Sea. The diplomatic notice followed meetings between senior US officials and Chevron CEO Mike Wirth, whose company chartered one of the four tankers recently targeted by Ukrainian forces near the Russian port of Novorossiysk. Novorossiysk serves as the terminus for the Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC), which supplies 2% of global daily crude oil and is considered by Washington as a vital alternative to Russian energy for European markets. Chevron holds significant stakes in the CPC and the connected Tengiz oil field in Kazakhstan.

data.title: Organizer of Targeted Drone Exhibition Near Kyiv Detained
data.description: The chief organizer of a defense technology exhibition struck by a Russian ballistic missile near Kyiv has been detained and notified of suspicion of criminal negligence. Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko stated that the event, which resulted in 10 fatalities and 100 injuries, was organized without authorization from military or regional administrations. Kravchenko noted that organizers invited over 300 people to an open location with only a 34-square-meter shelter situated approximately 100 meters away. The organizer is currently under guard in a medical facility, and authorities have conducted searches at the association’s office.

data.title: Ukraine Plans $1.1 Billion Satellite Constellation to Reduce Reliance on Starlink
data.description: Ukrainian satellite communications company Stetman is proceeding with a $1.1 billion plan to deploy a nationally controlled 360-satellite network by 2030 to reduce reliance on foreign-operated services such as Starlink. Working through a joint venture named UASAT with Danish manufacturer GomSpace, the constellation is designed to serve state and military users and withstand electronic warfare. The first 120 satellites are slated for a 2027 launch with SpaceX.

data.title: Romania Shoots Down Second Intruding Drone in 2 Days
data.description: A Romanian F-16 fighter jet intercepted and shot down an unidentified drone that penetrated the country’s airspace on Saturday, July 25, marking the second such incident in two days. The Ministry of National Defense reported that radar systems detected the drone near the Ukrainian border before it was neutralized in an unpopulated area near Sfântu Gheorghe. Romanian President Nicușor Dan confirmed the interception, and the defense ministry noted that the same pilot was responsible for both recent shootdowns.

data.title: Drone Strike Sparks Fire at Tyumen Oil Refinery in Russia’s Ural Region
data.description: A drone strike caused a fire at the Tyumen Oil Refinery (TNPZ) in Russia on Saturday, July 25. Regional Governor Alexander Moor confirmed that a drone fell on the facility’s territory, prompting an emergency response. Local residents reported hearing explosions and air defense activity, alongside visible smoke. The Tyumen refinery, formerly the Antipinsky Refinery, is the only large oil processing facility in the Ural Federal District, with a capacity of roughly 8 million tons annually. It was previously targeted in June 2026 and October 2025.

data.description: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) detained a resident of Dnipro accused of organizing a large-scale scheme to illegally verify and activate more than 1,000 Starlink satellite terminals for Russian forces. data.title: Russian Sheskharis Oil Terminal Suspends Loading After Ukrainian Drone Strikes
data.description: Russia’s largest Black Sea oil port, the Sheskharis terminal in Novorossiysk, has suspended operations following an increase in Ukrainian drone attacks in the surrounding region. Shipping data and satellite imagery confirm the facility has not loaded crude oil since July 22. While bad weather can disrupt operations, a storm warning did not take effect until late Thursday, two days after the final loading occurred. The shutdown follows heightened drone activity that also prevented tankers from collecting barrels at the nearby Caspian Pipeline Consortium terminal this week. The Sheskharis terminal typically ships an average of 650,000 barrels per day.

data.title: US-Iran War: Latest Developments
data.description: The conflict between the US and Iran has escalated significantly, with mutual strikes reported across several Middle Eastern nations. Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) issued a public warning on Friday for civilians to stay at least 500 meters away from US military personnel. Iranian state media claimed forces launched drone strikes against US military facilities in Bahrain, Jordan, Kuwait, and Iraq, alongside an alleged strike on an Amazon data center in Bahrain. Simultaneously, US forces conducted a 13th consecutive night of strikes against Iranian military targets. Iranian authorities reported that US strikes in Khuzestan province killed at least four people and injured five, while a separate US attack damaged an IRGC naval base in Gilan province.

data.title: US Downs Shahed with Ukraine-Tested Merops Drone
data.description: The US military downed an Iranian Shahed-type drone in Kuwait this week, marking the first combat interception by American forces using the Merops drone system. The $15,000 interceptor – developed by the US initiative Project Eagle – was previously tested and widely used by Ukrainian forces to destroy over 1,000 Russian-launched drones. The AI-equipped drone operates effectively in electronic warfare environments and is controlled via standard Xbox controllers.

data.title: Why isn't Jordan telling its people the whole story?
data.description: TEHRAN - In recent days, as the United States resumed military attacks against Iran and the regional conflict entered a new phase, Jordan has sought to present a carefully managed image of its role in the crisis to its domestic audience. The official narrative from Amman revolves around one central message: Jordan is not a party to the war; it is merely defending its airspace and territorial security. Jordanian officials have repeatedly stressed that any missile or drone entering the country's airspace constitutes a threat to national security and that the armed forces will respond accordingly.

data.title: Why Aramco Stands Alone
data.description:
Introduction: Redefining the Geopolitics of Capital
In traditional international political economy literature, the strategic posture of Middle Eastern energy titans is typically evaluated through the lens of supply security and price stabilization. Recent structural shifts in global financial markets, however, reveal a fundamental evolution in their core function: these mega corporations have transitioned from mere commodity suppliers into primary liquidity pumpers across Western financial arteries.

data.description: In the early hours of Friday, July 17, 2026, a U.S. strike on a rural bridge along the old Bandar Abbas–Khamir road changed the lives of several families forever. data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. data.title: De l’ombre de l’Euro à l’Eco : une souveraineté monétaire encore à conquérir?
data.description: Réuni le 19 juillet 2026 à Freetown pour sa 69e session ordinaire, le sommet de la CEDEAO a réaffirmé son intention de lancer l’Eco, la monnaie unique ouest-africaine, en 2027. Une échéance déjà repoussée à plusieurs reprises depuis l’annonce initiale du projet en 2000, et qui relance un débat vieux de plusieurs décennies : celui de la tutelle monétaire exercée par la France et, à travers elle, par l’euro, sur une partie du continent africain. Lire aussi:Visa américain : voici pourquoi les Béninois doivent désormais passer par Lomé Un projet régional né de la volonté d’émancipation monétaire L’idée d’une monnaie […]
data.translatedTitle: From the shadow of the Euro to the Eco: monetary sovereignty still to be conquered?
data.translatedDescription: Meeting on July 19, 2026 in Freetown for its 69th ordinary session, the ECOWAS summit reaffirmed its intention to launch the Eco, the single West African currency, in 2027. A deadline already postponed several times since the initial announcement of the project in 2000, and which rekindles a decades-old debate: that of the monetary supervision exercised by France and, through it, by the euro, on part of the African continent. data.title: Ciclismo: el uruguayo Thomas Silva se impuso en la 103° Clásica de Ordizia, en España
data.description: El fernandino, como se preveía, fue el más rápido de la mítica prueba vasca y superó al español Igor Arrieta y al portugués Antonio Morgado.
data.translatedTitle: Cycling: Uruguayan Thomas Silva won the 103rd Ordizia Classic, in Spain
data.translatedDescription: The Fernandino, as expected, was the fastest in the legendary Basque test and surpassed the Spanish Igor Arrieta and the Portuguese Antonio Morgado.

data.title: Fede Valverde no jugó el primer amistoso de Real Madrid y entrenó con juveniles. ¿Por qué?
data.description: El volante uruguayo se sumó a la pretemporada del equipo de José Mourinho el pasado miércoles. Podría jugar el próximo martes ante Leganés.
data.translatedTitle: Fede Valverde did not play in Real Madrid's first friendly and trained with youth players. Because?
data.translatedDescription: The Uruguayan midfielder joined the preseason of José Mourinho's team last Wednesday. He could play next Tuesday against Leganés.

data.title: Vozinha, arquero caboverdiano sensación del Mundial 2026, jugará en el fútbol sudamericano
data.description: Luego de que se cayera el pase de Santiago Mele, Colo Colo de Chile decidió avanzar por el golero con más seguidores en Instagram del mundo.
data.translatedTitle: Vozinha, Cape Verdean goalkeeper who is a sensation at the 2026 World Cup, will play in South American soccer
data.translatedDescription: After Santiago Mele's pass fell, Colo Colo from Chile decided to advance for the goalkeeper with the most followers on Instagram in the world.

data.title: Una multitud despidió a Jayden Adams, futbolista sudafricano que falleció tras el Mundial
data.description: El volante de 25 años murió en circunstancias que siguen bajo investigación. Messi, Cristiano y Haaland enviaron condolencias a la familia.
data.translatedTitle: A crowd bid farewell to Jayden Adams, a South African footballer who died after the World Cup
data.translatedDescription: The 25-year-old midfielder died in circumstances that remain under investigation. Messi, Cristiano and Haaland sent condolences to the family.

data.title: “Carencias de insumos y dinero”: tercerizados del Mides denuncian atrasos salariales
data.description: En un comunicado, el sindicato asegura que hay un clima de “inseguridad laboral” que se vive desde hace más de un año.
data.translatedTitle: “Lack of supplies and money”: Mides outsourcers denounce salary arrears
data.translatedDescription: In a statement, the union assures that there is a climate of “job insecurity” that has been experienced for more than a year.

data.title: “Disputa interna”: Alianza País realizó congreso y criticó rumbo económico del FA
data.description: El sector emitió una declaración en la que afirma que la “inacción del gobierno y su falta de rumbo y liderazgo son preocupantes”.
data.translatedTitle: “Internal dispute”: Alianza País held a congress and criticized the economic direction of the FA
data.translatedDescription: The sector issued a statement saying the government's “inaction and lack of direction and leadership are worrying.”

data.title: BPS confirmó cómo será el aumento de las jubilaciones mínimas que se pagará en agosto
data.description: El organismo valoró que el incremento de las pasividades haya alcanzado el 5,97% en el período actual, un 2,32% por encima de la inflación.
data.translatedTitle: BPS confirmed how the increase in minimum pensions that will be paid in August will be
data.translatedDescription: The organization assessed that the increase in liabilities has reached 5.97% in the current period, 2.32% above inflation.

data.title: Tragedia en Florida: murió el quinto ocupante del auto en el que viajaba una familia
data.description: El siniestro ocurrió en la ruta 56 en el mes de marzo. La víctima había sido trasladada de urgencia y se encontraba en CTI.
data.translatedTitle: Tragedy in Florida: the fifth occupant of the car in which a family was traveling died
data.translatedDescription: The accident occurred on Route 56 in the month of March. The victim had been rushed to hospital and was in CTI.

data.title: El órgano más grande del país: cómo transformó la Catedral de Salto y su valor millonario
data.description: Con 2.500 tubos, el instrumento atrae jóvenes, conciertos y proyecta a la ciudad del litoral como referencia nacional.

data.translatedDescription: With 2,500 pipes, the instrument attracts young people, concerts and projects the coastal city as a national reference.
